1. Paṇṇattivāro

1. The Section on Concepts

(Ka) uddeso

1. Tayo [M 2.0001][V 2.0001] saṅkhārā – kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro, cittasaṅkhāroti. Assāsapassāsā kāyasaṅkhāro, vitakkavicārā vacīsaṅkhāro, saññā ca vedanā ca cittasaṅkhāro. Ṭhapetvā vitakkavicāre sabbepi cittasampayuttakā dhammā cittasaṅkhāro.

1. There are three formations: bodily formation, verbal formation, and mental formation. In-and-out breathing is bodily formation; initial and sustained thought are verbal formation; perception and feeling are mental formation. Excluding initial and sustained thought, all phenomena associated with the mind are mental formation.

8. (Ka) kāyo [M 2.0003][V 2.0005] kāyasaṅkhāroti? No.

8. (Ka) Is the body a bodily formation? No.

(Kha) kāyasaṅkhāro kāyoti? No.

(Kha) Is a bodily formation the body? No.

(Ka) vacī vacīsaṅkhāroti? No.

(Ka) Is speech a verbal formation? No.

(Kha) vacīsaṅkhāro vacīti? No.

(Kha) Is a verbal formation speech? No.

(Ka) cittaṃ cittasaṅkhāroti? No.

(Ka) Is the mind a mental formation? No.

(Kha) cittasaṅkhāro cittanti? No.

(Kha) Is a mental formation the mind? No.

(Kha) paccanīkaṃ

(Kha) Negative Method

9. (Ka) na kāyo na kāyasaṅkhāroti?

9. (Ka) Is that which is not the body not a bodily formation?

Kāyasaṅkhāro na kāyo, kāyasaṅkhāro. Kāyañca kāyasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva kāyo na ca kāyasaṅkhāro.

A bodily formation is not the body; it is a bodily formation. Having set aside the body and a bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor a bodily formation.

(Kha) na kāyasaṅkhāro na kāyoti?

(Kha) Is that which is not a bodily formation not the body?

Kāyo na kāyasaṅkhāro, kāyo. Kāyañca kāyasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva kāyo na ca kāyasaṅkhāro.

The body is not a bodily formation; it is the body. Having set aside the body and a bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor a bodily formation.

(Ka) na vacī na vacīsaṅkhāroti?

Is that which is not speech not a verbal formation?

Vacīsaṅkhāro na vacī, vacīsaṅkhāro. Vaciñca vacīsaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva vacī na ca vacīsaṅkhāro.

A verbal formation is not speech; it is a verbal formation. Having set aside speech and a verbal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor a verbal formation.

(Kha) na vacīsaṅkhāro na vacīti?

Is that which is not a verbal formation not speech?

Vacī na vacīsaṅkhāro, vacī. Vaciñca vacīsaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva vacī na ca vacīsaṅkhāro.

Speech is not a verbal formation; it is speech. Having set aside speech and a verbal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor a verbal formation.

(Ka) na [V 2.0006] cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāroti?

Is that which is not the mind not a mental formation?

Cittasaṅkhāro na cittaṃ, cittasaṅkhāro. Cittañca cittasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cittaṃ na ca cittasaṅkhāro.

A mental formation is not the mind; it is a mental formation. Having set aside the mind and a mental formation, the remainder is neither the mind nor a mental formation.

(Kha) na cittasaṅkhāro na cittanti?

Is that which is not a mental formation not the mind?

Cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāro, cittaṃ. Cittañca cittasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cittaṃ na ca cittasaṅkhāro.

The mind is not a mental formation; it is the mind. Having set aside the mind and a mental formation, the remainder is neither the mind nor a mental formation.

A bodily formation is not the body; it is a bodily formation. Having set aside the body and a bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor a bodily formation.

Kāyasaṅkhāro na kāyo, kāyasaṅkhāro. Kāyañca kāyasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva kāyo na ca kāyasaṅkhāro.

A bodily formation is not the body; it is a bodily formation. Having set aside the body and a bodily formation, the remainder is neither the body nor a bodily formation.

(Kha) na saṅkhārā na cittasaṅkhāroti? Āmantā.

Are those which are not formations not a mental formation? Yes.

14. (Ka) na vacī na vacīsaṅkhāroti?

14. Is that which is not speech not a verbal formation?

Vacīsaṅkhāro na vacī, vacīsaṅkhāro. Vaciñca vacīsaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva vacī na ca vacīsaṅkhāro.

A verbal formation is not speech; it is a verbal formation. Having set aside speech and a verbal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor a verbal formation.

(Kha) na saṅkhārā na kāyasaṅkhāroti? Āmantā.

(Ka) na [V 2.0008] vacī na vacīsaṅkhāroti?

Is that which is not speech not a verbal formation?

Vacīsaṅkhāro na vacī, vacīsaṅkhāro. Vaciñca vacīsaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva vacī na ca vacīsaṅkhāro.

A verbal formation is not speech; it is a verbal formation. Having set aside speech and a verbal formation, the remainder is neither speech nor a verbal formation.

(Kha) na saṅkhārā na cittasaṅkhāroti? Āmantā.

Are non-formations not a mental formation? Yes.

15. (Ka) na [M 2.0005] cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāroti?

15. Is that which is not mind not a mental formation?

Cittasaṅkhāro na cittaṃ, cittasaṅkhāro. Cittañca cittasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cittaṃ na ca cittasaṅkhāro.

A mental formation is not mind; it is a mental formation. Setting aside mind and mental formation, the remaining phenomena are neither mind nor a mental formation.

(Kha) na saṅkhārā na kāyasaṅkhāroti? Āmantā.

Are non-formations not a bodily formation? Yes.

(Ka) na cittaṃ na cittasaṅkhāroti?

Is that which is not mind not a mental formation?

Cittasaṅkhāro na cittaṃ, cittasaṅkhāro. Cittañca cittasaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva cittaṃ na ca cittasaṅkhāro.

A mental formation is not mind; it is a mental formation. Setting aside mind and mental formation, the remaining phenomena are neither mind nor a mental formation.

(Kha) na saṅkhārā na vacīsaṅkhāroti? Āmantā.

Are non-formations not a verbal formation? Yes.

Vacīsaṅkhāro na kāyasaṅkhāro, vacīsaṅkhāro. Kāyasaṅkhārañca vacīsaṅkhārañca ṭhapetvā avasesā na ceva kāyasaṅkhāro na ca vacīsaṅkhāro.

2. Pavattivāro 1. uppādavāro

2. Chapter on Occurrence. 1. Section on Arising.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

The Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

The Section on Persons (Direct Order)

19. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0010] kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

19. For one for whom the bodily formation is arising, for them is the verbal formation arising?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths without applied and sustained thought, for them the bodily formation is arising, but for them the verbal formation is not arising. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those of the sense-sphere, at the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them both the bodily formation is arising and the verbal formation is arising.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the verbal formation is arising, for them is the bodily formation arising?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of applied and sustained thought without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them the verbal formation is arising, but for them the bodily formation is not arising. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those of the sense-sphere, at the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them both the verbal formation is arising and the bodily formation is arising.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the bodily formation is arising, for them is the mental formation arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the mental formation is arising, for them is the bodily formation arising?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them the mental formation is arising, but for them the bodily formation is not arising. At the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them both the mental formation is arising and the bodily formation is arising.

20. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

20. For one for whom the verbal formation is arising, for them is the mental formation arising? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the mental formation is arising, for them is the verbal formation arising?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of consciousness without applied and sustained thought, for them the mental formation is arising, but for them the verbal formation is not arising. At the moment of the arising of applied and sustained thought, for them both the mental formation is arising and the verbal formation is arising.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Section on Location (Direct Order)

21. (Ka) yattha [M 2.0007][V 2.0011] kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

21. (Ka) Where the bodily formation is arising, is the verbal formation arising there?

Dutiyajjhāne tatiyajjhāne tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati. Paṭhamajjhāne kāmāvacare tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

In the second jhāna and in the third jhāna, there the bodily formation is arising, but there the verbal formation is not arising. In the first jhāna and in the sense-sphere, there both the bodily formation is arising and the verbal formation is arising.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, where the verbal formation is arising, is the bodily formation arising there?

Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Paṭhamajjhāne kāmāvacare tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

In the form-sphere and in the formless-sphere, there the verbal formation is arising, but there the bodily formation is not arising. In the first jhāna and in the sense-sphere, there both the verbal formation is arising and the bodily formation is arising.

(Ka) yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Where the bodily formation is arising, is the mental formation arising there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, where the mental formation is arising, is the bodily formation arising there?

Catutthajjhāne rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Paṭhamajjhāne dutiyajjhāne tatiyajjhāne kāmāvacare tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

In the fourth jhāna, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, there the mental formation is arising, but there the bodily formation is not arising. In the first jhāna, the second jhāna, the third jhāna, and in the sense-sphere, there both the mental formation is arising and the bodily formation is arising.

22. (Ka) yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

22. (Ka) Where the verbal formation is arising, is the mental formation arising there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, where the mental formation is arising, is the verbal formation arising there?

Dutiyajjhāne tatiyajjhāne catutthajjhāne tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati. Paṭhamajjhāne kāmāvacare rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

In the second jhāna, the third jhāna, and the fourth jhāna, there the mental formation is arising, but there the verbal formation is not arising. In the first jhāna, in the sense-sphere, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, there both the mental formation is arising and the verbal formation is arising.

24. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0012] kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

24. (Ka) For whomever the bodily formation does not arise, for them does the verbal formation not arise?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi avitakkaavicāracittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of applied and sustained thought without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them the bodily formation does not arise, but it is not that for them the verbal formation does not arise. For all at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness without applied and sustained thought and without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the bodily formation and the verbal formation do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro [M 2.0008] nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the verbal formation does not arise, for them does the bodily formation not arise?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi avitakkaavicāracittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths without applied and sustained thought, for them the verbal formation does not arise, but it is not that for them the bodily formation does not arise. For all at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness without applied and sustained thought and without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the verbal formation and the bodily formation do not arise.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

(Ka) For whomever the bodily formation does not arise, for them does the mental formation not arise?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the moment of the arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them the bodily formation does not arise, but it is not that for them the mental formation does not arise. For all at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the bodily formation and the mental formation do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the mental formation does not arise, for them does the bodily formation not arise? Yes.

25. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

For all at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the verbal formation and the mental formation do not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomever the mental formation does not arise, for them does the verbal formation not arise? Yes.

26. (Ka) yattha [V 2.0013] kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

26. (Ka) Where the bodily formation is not arising, is the verbal formation not arising there?

Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Catutthajjhāne asaññasatte tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

In the form-sphere and in the formless-sphere, there the bodily formation is not arising, but it is not that there the verbal formation is not arising. In the fourth jhāna and for non-percipient beings, there both the bodily formation and the verbal formation are not arising.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Dutiyajjhāne tatiyajjhāne tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Catutthajjhāne asaññasatte tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

In the second jhāna and the third jhāna, there the verbal formation is not arising, but it is not that there the bodily formation is not arising. In the fourth jhāna and for non-percipient beings, there both the verbal formation and the bodily formation are not arising.

(Ka) yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Catutthajjhāne rūpāvacare arūpāvacare tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Asaññasatte tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

In the fourth jhāna, the form-sphere, and the formless-sphere, there the bodily formation is not arising, but it is not that there the mental formation is not arising. For non-percipient beings, there both the bodily formation and the mental formation are not arising.

28. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

28. For whom, in which plane, bodily formation is not arising, for that person, in that plane, is verbal formation not arising?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi avitakkaavicāracittassa [V 2.0014] uppādakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

32. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0010][V 2.0015] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

32. (a) For whomever, in whatsoever sphere, the bodily formation has arisen, for them, in that sphere, has the verbal formation arisen?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them, in that sphere, the bodily formation has arisen, but the verbal formation has not arisen for them in that sphere. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those in the sense-sphere, for them, in that sphere, both the bodily formation has arisen and the verbal formation has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whomever, in whatsoever sphere, the verbal formation has arisen, for them, in that sphere, has the bodily formation arisen?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For those in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, for them, in that sphere, the verbal formation has arisen, but the bodily formation has not arisen for them in that sphere. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those in the sense-sphere, for them, in that sphere, both the verbal formation has arisen and the bodily formation has arisen.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever, in whatsoever sphere, the bodily formation has arisen, for them, in that sphere, has the mental formation arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whomever, in whatsoever sphere, the mental formation has arisen, for them, in that sphere, has the bodily formation arisen?

Catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For those who have attained the fourth jhāna, for those in the fine-material sphere, and for those in the immaterial sphere, for them, in that sphere, the mental formation has arisen, but the bodily formation has not arisen for them in that sphere. For those who have attained the first jhāna, the second jhāna, and the third jhāna, and for those in the sense-sphere, for them, in that sphere, both the mental formation has arisen and the bodily formation has arisen.

33. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

33. (a) For whomever, in whatsoever sphere, the verbal formation has arisen, for them, in that sphere, has the mental formation arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whomever, in whatsoever sphere, the mental formation has arisen, for them, in that sphere, has the verbal formation arisen?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye [V 2.0016] citte vattamāne tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ itaresaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For those who have attained the second jhāna, the third jhāna, and the fourth jhāna, and for those in the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, for them, in that sphere, the mental formation has arisen, but the verbal formation has not arisen for them in that sphere. For those who have attained the first jhāna, for those in the sense-sphere, and for the other beings in the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere, for them, in that sphere, both the mental formation has arisen and the verbal formation has arisen.

For the others, both verbal formation and bodily formation will arise for them.

42. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0019] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

42. (Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane, bodily formation will arise, for them, in that plane, will verbal formation arise?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ [M 2.0013] samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those who have attained the second and third jhānas, for them, in that plane, bodily formation will arise, but verbal formation will not arise for them. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those of the sense-sphere, for them, in that plane, both bodily formation and verbal formation will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(Kha) Or for whomever, in whichever plane, verbal formation will arise, for them, in that plane, will bodily formation arise?

Yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those of the sense-sphere for whom the final consciousness will arise immediately after a certain consciousness, and for those of the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them, in that plane, verbal formation will arise, but bodily formation will not arise for them. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for the other beings of the sense-sphere, for them, in that plane, both verbal formation and bodily formation will arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomever, in whichever plane, bodily formation will arise, for them, in that plane, will mental formation arise? Yes.

Yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those of the sense-sphere for whom the final consciousness will arise immediately after a certain consciousness; for those who have entered into the fourth jhāna; and for those of the form-sphere and formless-sphere—for them, in that state, mental formation will arise, but bodily formation will not arise for them there. For those who have entered into the first, second, and third jhānas, and for other persons of the sense-sphere, both mental formation and bodily formation will arise for them there.

For those who have entered into the first jhāna, for persons of the sense-sphere, and for the other persons of the form-sphere and formless-sphere, both mental formation and verbal formation will arise for them there.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Progressive Order Regarding the Person

49. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

49. (Ka) For a person for whom bodily formation is arising, has verbal formation arisen for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for a person for whom verbal formation has arisen, is bodily formation arising for them?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha[V 2.0023], no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For all those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them verbal formation has arisen, but for them bodily formation is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them both verbal formation has arisen and bodily formation is arising.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for a person for whom mental formation has arisen, is bodily formation arising for them?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For those at the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them both mental formation has arisen and bodily formation is arising.

For those who have attained the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings at the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them in that plane both verbal formation has arisen and bodily formation is arising.

For all those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them in that plane mental formation has arisen, but for them in that plane bodily formation is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them in that plane both mental formation has arisen and bodily formation is arising.

53. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0017] yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

53. (Ka) For a person for whom verbal formation is arising in a certain plane, has mental formation arisen for them in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for a person for whom mental formation has arisen in a certain plane, is verbal formation arising for them in that plane?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro [V 2.0025] uppajjati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For all those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without applied and sustained thought, for them in that plane mental formation has arisen, but for them in that plane verbal formation is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of applied and sustained thought, for them in that plane both mental formation has arisen and verbal formation is arising.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative Order Regarding the Person

54. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

57. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti?

57. (Ka) For whom, in a plane where the bodily formation is not arising, for them in that plane did the verbal formation not arise?

Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha. Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ suddhāvāsānaṃ [V 2.0026] dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha.

For those who have attained the first jhāna, for sense-sphere beings at the moment of dissolution of in-and-out breathing, for those same beings at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, and for beings of the form sphere and the formless sphere: for them in that plane the bodily formation is not arising, but for them in that plane the verbal formation did arise. For those who have attained the second and third jhānas, for those at the moment of dissolution of in-and-out breathing, for those same beings at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, for those who have attained the fourth jhāna, for beings of the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings: for them in that plane both the bodily formation is not arising and the verbal formation did not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro [M 2.0018] nuppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom, in a plane where the verbal formation did not arise, for them in that plane is the bodily formation not arising?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

For those who have attained the second and third jhānas at the moment of arising of in-and-out breathing: for them in that plane the verbal formation did not arise, but for them in that plane the bodily formation is arising. For those who have attained the second and third jhānas at the moment of dissolution of in-and-out breathing, for those same beings at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, for those who have attained the fourth jhāna, for beings of the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring, and for non-percipient beings: for them in that plane both the verbal formation did not arise and the bodily formation is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whom, in a plane where the bodily formation is not arising, for them in that plane did the mental formation not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha.

For all at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-and-out breathing: for them in that plane the bodily formation is not arising, but for them in that plane the mental formation did arise. For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings: for them in that plane both the bodily formation is not arising and the mental formation did not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom, in a plane where the mental formation did not arise, for them in that plane is the bodily formation not arising? Yes.

58. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti?

58. (Ka) For whom, in a plane where the verbal formation is not arising, for them in that plane did the mental formation not arise?

For all at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, and for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without initial and sustained thought: for them in that plane the verbal formation is not arising, but for them in that plane the mental formation did arise. For those who are being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings: for them in that plane both the verbal formation is not arising and the mental formation did not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom, in a plane where... (etc.)... ? Yes.

59. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0027] kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom the verbal formation will arise, does the bodily formation arise for them?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For all those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, the verbal formation will arise, but the bodily formation is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of in-and-out breathing, for them, the verbal formation will arise and the bodily formation is also arising.

(Ka) yassa [M 2.0019] kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whom the bodily formation arises, will the mental formation arise for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the mental formation will arise, does the bodily formation arise for them?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For all those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, the mental formation will arise, but the bodily formation is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of in-and-out breathing, for them, the mental formation will arise and the bodily formation is also arising.

60. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

60. (Ka) For whom the verbal formation arises, will the mental formation arise for them?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness with initial and sustained thought, the verbal formation is arising, but for them the mental formation will not arise. For those at the arising moment of other initial and sustained thoughts, for them the verbal formation is also arising and the mental formation will also arise.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0028] vā pana cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom the mental formation will arise, does the verbal formation arise for them?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For all those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of arising of consciousness without initial and sustained thoughts, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, the mental formation will arise, but the verbal formation is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of initial and sustained thoughts, for them the mental formation will arise and the verbal formation is also arising.

62. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

62. For whom a bodily formation is arising in a plane, will a verbal formation arise for them in that plane?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those who have attained the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings at the moment of arising of in-and-out breathing, for them there both the bodily formation is arising and the verbal formation will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

Or, for a person for whom a verbal formation will arise in a certain plane, is a bodily formation arising for them in that plane?

Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. For those who have attained the first jhāna; for sense-sphere beings at the moment of dissolution of in-breaths and out-breaths; for those same persons at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; and for fine-material-sphere and immaterial-sphere beings—for them, there, a verbal formation will arise, but for them, there, a bodily formation is not arising. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings at the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, there, both a verbal formation will arise and a bodily formation is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0029] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom a bodily formation is arising in a certain plane, will a mental formation arise for them in that plane? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

Or, for a person for whom a mental formation will arise in a certain plane, is a bodily formation arising for them in that plane?

At the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, there, both a mental formation will arise and a bodily formation is arising.

Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

For those who have attained the first jhāna; for sense-sphere beings at the dissolution-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those same beings at the arising-moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; and for fine-material-sphere and immaterial-sphere beings—for them, there, a bodily formation is not arising, but a verbal formation will arise for them. For those endowed with the final consciousness; for those for whom the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness; for those who have attained the second and third jhānas; for those at the dissolution-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those same beings at the arising-moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them, there, both a bodily formation is not arising and a verbal formation will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever, in whatever plane, verbal formation will not arise, for them, in that plane, is bodily formation not arising?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no [M 2.0022] ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

For those who have attained the second and third jhānas, at the arising-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, there, verbal formation will not arise, but bodily formation is arising for them. For those endowed with the final consciousness, for whom the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness; for those who have attained the second and third jhānas at the dissolution-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those same beings at the arising-moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them, there, verbal formation will not arise, and bodily formation is not arising.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissatīti?

For whomever, in whatever plane, bodily formation is not arising, for them, in that plane, will mental formation not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro [V 2.0032] nuppajjissati. Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

For all beings at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and at the arising-moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, there, bodily formation is not arising, but mental formation will arise for them. For those endowed with the final consciousness and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, bodily formation is not arising, and mental formation will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for whomever, in whatever plane, mental formation will not arise, for them, in that plane, is bodily formation not arising? Yes.

68. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissatīti?

68. For whomever, in whatever plane, verbal formation is not arising, for them, in that plane, will mental formation not arise?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

For all beings at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, and at the arising-moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought, for them, there, verbal formation is not arising, but mental formation will arise for them. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought, for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, verbal formation is not arising, and mental formation will not arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Or again, for whomever, in whatever plane, mental formation will not arise, for them, in that plane, is verbal formation not arising?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the arising-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought, for them, there, mental formation will not arise, but verbal formation is arising for them. At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought, for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought, and for non-percipient beings, for them, there, both mental formation will not arise and verbal formation is not arising.

(6) The Section on the Past and Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: Person

69. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

69. For whomever bodily formation has arisen, for them will verbal formation arise?

Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro [V 2.0033] uppajjissati[M 2.0023]. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the final consciousness, and for those for whom the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness, for them bodily formation has arisen, but for them verbal formation will not arise. For the others, for them both bodily formation has arisen and verbal formation will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomever verbal formation will arise, for them has bodily formation arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

For whomever bodily formation has arisen, for them will mental formation arise?

Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the final consciousness, for them bodily formation has arisen, but for them mental formation will not arise. For the others, for them both bodily formation has arisen and mental formation will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…. Āmantā.

Or for whomever mental formation will arise, for them has bodily formation arisen? Yes.

70. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

70. For whomever verbal formation has arisen, for them will mental formation arise?

Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those endowed with the final consciousness, for them verbal formation has arisen, but for them mental formation will not arise. For the others, for them both verbal formation has arisen and mental formation will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomever mental formation will arise, for them has verbal formation arisen? Yes.

71. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha…pe….

71. Where bodily formation has arisen… and so on….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive: Person and Plane

72. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

72. For whichever person bodily formation has arisen in whichever plane, for that person will verbal formation arise in that plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those in the sensuous sphere endowed with the final consciousness, and for those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them bodily formation has arisen there, but for them verbal formation will not arise there. For those who have attained the first jhāna, and for the other beings of the sensuous sphere, for them both bodily formation has arisen there and verbal formation will arise there.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0034] vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

Or for whichever person verbal formation will arise in whichever plane, for that person has bodily formation arisen in that plane?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For beings of the form sphere and the formless sphere, for them verbal formation will arise there, but for them bodily formation has not arisen there. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for beings of the sensuous sphere, for them both verbal formation will arise there and bodily formation has arisen there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

For whichever person bodily formation has arisen in whichever plane, for that person will mental formation arise in that plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those in the sensuous sphere endowed with the final consciousness, for them bodily formation has arisen there, but for them mental formation will not arise there. For those who have attained the first, second, and third jhānas, and for the other beings of the sensuous sphere, for them both bodily formation has arisen there and mental formation will arise there.

(Kha) yassa [M 2.0024] vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

Or for whichever person mental formation will arise in whichever plane, for that person has bodily formation arisen in that plane?

Catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For those who have attained the fourth jhāna, and for beings of the form sphere and the formless sphere, for them mental formation will arise there, but for them bodily formation has not arisen there. For those who have attained the first, second, and third jhānas, and for beings of the sensuous sphere, for them both mental formation will arise there and bodily formation has arisen there.

73. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

73. (a) For whichever person verbal formation has arisen in whichever plane, for that person will mental formation arise in that plane?

Savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those in the plane with applied and sustained thought who are endowed with the final consciousness, for them verbal formation has arisen there, but for them mental formation will not arise there. For the others in the plane with applied and sustained thought, for them both verbal formation has arisen there and mental formation will arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whichever person mental formation will arise in whichever plane, for that person has verbal formation arisen in that plane?

Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no [V 2.0035] ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjittha. Savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjittha.

For those in the plane without applied and sustained thought, for them mental formation will arise there, but for them verbal formation has not arisen there. For those in the plane with applied and sustained thought, for them both mental formation will arise there and verbal formation has arisen there.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(b) Or for whichever person mental formation will not arise, for that person has bodily formation not arisen? It has arisen.

75. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissatīti? Natthi.

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha, no [V 2.0036] ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

76. For beings of the form sphere and the formless sphere, for them bodily formation has not arisen there, but verbal formation will arise for them there. For those in the form sphere and the formless sphere who are endowed with the final consciousness, for those for whom the final consciousness that is without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness, for those who have attained the fourth jhāna, and for non-percipient beings—for them, both bodily formation has not arisen there and verbal formation will not arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane verbal formation will not arise, for that person, in that plane has bodily formation not arisen?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha.

77. For those in the sensuous sphere who are endowed with the final consciousness, and for those who have attained the second and third jhānas, for them verbal formation will not arise there, but bodily formation has arisen for them there. For those in the form and formless spheres who are endowed with the final consciousness, for those for whom the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness, for those who have attained the fourth jhāna, and for non-percipient beings—for them, both verbal formation will not arise there and bodily formation has not arisen there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissatīti?

(a) For whichever person, in whichever plane bodily formation has not arisen, for that person, in that plane will mental formation not arise?

Catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

For those who have attained the fourth jhāna, and for beings of the form sphere and the formless sphere, for them bodily formation has not arisen there, but mental formation will arise for them there. For those in the form and formless spheres who are endowed with the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them both bodily formation has not arisen there and mental formation will not arise there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane mental formation will not arise, for that person, in that plane has bodily formation not arisen?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha.

For those in the sensuous sphere who are endowed with the final consciousness, for them mental formation will not arise there, but bodily formation has arisen for them there. For those in the form and formless spheres who are endowed with the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them both mental formation will not arise there and bodily formation has not arisen there.

78. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissatīti?

(a) For whichever person, in whichever plane verbal formation has not arisen, for that person, in that plane will mental formation not arise?

Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati. Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

For those in the plane without applied and sustained thought, for them verbal formation has not arisen there, but mental formation will arise for them there. For those in the plane without applied and sustained thought who are endowed with the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them both verbal formation has not arisen there and mental formation will not arise there.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0037] vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjitthāti?

(b) Or for whichever person, in whichever plane mental formation will not arise, for that person, in that plane has verbal formation not arisen?

Savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ tattha [M 2.0026] cittasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjittha. Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjittha.

78. For those in the plane with applied and sustained thought who are endowed with the final consciousness, for them mental formation will not arise there, but verbal formation has arisen for them there. For those in the plane without applied and sustained thought who are endowed with the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them both mental formation will not arise there and verbal formation has not arisen there.

Uppādavāro.

The Section on Arising.

2. Nirodhavāro

The Section on Cessation

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) The Positive Person

79. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

79. For whom the bodily formation is ceasing, for them is the verbal formation ceasing?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of in-breaths and out-breaths without applied and sustained thought, their bodily formation is ceasing, but their verbal formation is not ceasing. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings, at the moment of dissolution of their in-breaths and out-breaths, both their bodily formation and their verbal formation are ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the verbal formation is ceasing, for them is the bodily formation ceasing?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ [V 2.0038] samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of applied and sustained thought without in-breaths and out-breaths, their verbal formation is ceasing, but their bodily formation is not ceasing. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings, at the moment of dissolution of their in-breaths and out-breaths, both their verbal formation and their bodily formation are ceasing.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

For whom the bodily formation is ceasing, for them is the mental formation ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the mental formation is ceasing, for them is the bodily formation ceasing?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, their mental formation is ceasing, but their bodily formation is not ceasing. For those at the moment of dissolution of in-breaths and out-breaths, both their mental formation and their bodily formation are ceasing.

80. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

80. For whom the verbal formation is ceasing, for them is the mental formation ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for whom the mental formation is ceasing, for them is the verbal formation ceasing?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without applied and sustained thought, their mental formation is ceasing, but their verbal formation is not ceasing. For those at the moment of dissolution of applied and sustained thought, both their mental formation and their verbal formation are ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive: Location

81. Yattha [M 2.0027] kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?…Pe….

81. Where the bodily formation is ceasing, is the verbal formation ceasing there? …and so on…

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive: Person and Location

82. Yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?…Pe…. (Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ.)

82. For whom the bodily formation is ceasing in a certain location, for them is the verbal formation ceasing there? …and so on… (The section on the person and the section on the person and location are similar.)

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative: Person

83. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0039] kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

83. For whom the bodily formation is not ceasing, for them is the verbal formation not ceasing?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi avitakkaavicāracittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of applied and sustained thought without in-breaths and out-breaths, their bodily formation is not ceasing, but their verbal formation is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought and without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the verbal formation is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for whom the verbal formation is not ceasing, for them is the bodily formation not ceasing?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi avitakkaavicāracittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of in-breaths and out-breaths without applied and sustained thought, their verbal formation is not ceasing, but their bodily formation is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought and without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the verbal formation is not ceasing and the bodily formation is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

For whom the bodily formation is not ceasing, for them is the mental formation not ceasing?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, their bodily formation is not ceasing, but their mental formation is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the mental formation is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or, for whom the mental formation is not ceasing, for them is the bodily formation not ceasing? Yes.

84. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

84. For whom the verbal formation is not ceasing, for them is the mental formation not ceasing?

Vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought, their verbal formation is not ceasing, but their mental formation is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them both the verbal formation is not ceasing and the mental formation is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or, for whom the mental formation is not ceasing, for them is the verbal formation not ceasing? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāsā

(Ṅa) Negative: Location

85. Yattha [M 2.0028][V 2.0040] kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati…pe….

85. Where the bodily formation does not cease…and so on…
