(Ca) Negative: Person and Location

86. Yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

86. For whom the bodily formation is not ceasing in a certain plane, for them in that plane is the verbal formation not ceasing?

Vinā assāsapassāsehi vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi avitakkaavicāracittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those at the dissolution moment of applied and sustained thought without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them in that plane the bodily formation is not ceasing, but the verbal formation is ceasing. For all at the arising moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought and without in-breaths and out-breaths, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the verbal formation is not ceasing.

Yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati…pe….

Or again, for whom the verbal formation is not ceasing in a certain plane…and so on…

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ, yassayatthake nirodhasamāpannānanti na kātabbaṃ.)

(The sections on the Person and on the Person and Location should be elaborated similarly. In the Person and Location section, the case of those who have attained cessation should not be included.)

(2) Atītavāro

(2) Past Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: Person

87. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

87. For whom the bodily formation has ceased, for them has the verbal formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or again, for whom the verbal formation has ceased, for them has the bodily formation ceased? Yes.

(Yathā uppādavāre atītā pucchā yassakampi yassayatthakampi anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhattaṃ evaṃ nirodhavārepi vibhajitabbaṃ, natthi nānākaraṇaṃ.)

(Just as in the Arising Section the past questions concerning the Person and the Person-and-Occasion, both positive and negative, were analyzed, so too they should be analyzed in the Cessation Section; there is no difference.)

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) Future Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive: Person

88. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0397][V 2.0041] kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

88. (Ka) For whomsoever the bodily formation will cease, for them will the verbal formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever the verbal formation will cease, for them will the bodily formation cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ [M 2.0029] cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those in the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness will arise for sense-sphere beings, for those in their final existence in the form sphere and the formless sphere, and for those who, having been reborn into the form sphere or the formless sphere, will attain parinibbāna—for these beings who are passing away, their verbal formation will cease, but their bodily formation will not cease. For the others, both their verbal formation and their bodily formation will cease.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomsoever the bodily formation will cease, for them will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever the mental formation will cease, for them will the bodily formation cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those in the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness will arise for sense-sphere beings, for those in their final existence in the form sphere and the formless sphere, and for those who, having been reborn into the form sphere or the formless sphere, will attain parinibbāna—for these beings who are passing away, their mental formation will cease, but their bodily formation will not cease. For the others, both their mental formation and their bodily formation will cease.

89. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

89. (Ka) For whomsoever the verbal formation will cease, for them will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [T 1.0398][V 2.0042] vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever the mental formation will cease, for them will the verbal formation cease?

Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought, and for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise, for them the mental formation will cease, but their verbal formation will not cease. For the others, both their mental formation and their verbal formation will cease.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: Occasion

90. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati…pe….

90. Where the bodily formation will cease…pe….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive: Person-and-Occasion

91. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

91. (Ka) For whomsoever in whatsoever plane the bodily formation will cease, for them in that plane will the verbal formation cease?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them in that plane the bodily formation will cease, but for them in that plane the verbal formation will not cease. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those in the sense-sphere, for them in that plane both the bodily formation will cease and the verbal formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever in whatsoever plane the verbal formation will cease, for them in that plane will the bodily formation cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati[M 2.0030], no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those in the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness will arise for sense-sphere beings, and for those in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them in that plane the verbal formation will cease, but for them in that plane the bodily formation will not cease. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for the other sense-sphere beings, for them in that plane both the verbal formation will cease and the bodily formation will cease.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0043] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(Ka) For whomsoever in whatsoever plane the bodily formation will cease, for them in that plane will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro [T 1.0399] nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever in whatsoever plane the mental formation will cease, for them in that plane will the bodily formation cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those in the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness will arise for a sense-sphere being, for those who have attained the fourth jhāna, and for those in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them in that plane the mental formation will cease, but for them in that plane the bodily formation will not cease. For those who have attained the first, second, and third jhānas, and for the other sense-sphere beings, for them in that plane both the mental formation will cease and the bodily formation will cease.

92. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

92. (Ka) For whomsoever in whatsoever plane the verbal formation will cease, for them in that plane will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever in whatsoever plane the mental formation will cease, for them in that plane will the verbal formation cease?

Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ itaresaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise, and for those who have attained the second, third, and fourth jhānas, for them in that plane the mental formation will cease, but for them in that plane the verbal formation will not cease. For those who have attained the first jhāna, for those in the sense-sphere, and for the other beings in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them in that plane both the mental formation will cease and the verbal formation will cease.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) Negative: Person

93. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

93. (Ka) For whomsoever the bodily formation will not cease, for them will the verbal formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti [T 1.0400] tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ [V 2.0044] yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness of beings in the sense-sphere; for those for whom the final sense-sphere consciousness will arise immediately after a certain consciousness; for those in their final existence in the form sphere and the formless sphere; and for those who, having arisen in the form sphere or the formless sphere, will attain Parinibbāna—for them, while passing away, their bodily formation will not cease, but their verbal formation will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; and for those for whom the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness—for them, both the bodily formation will not cease and the verbal formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the verbal formation will not cease, for them will the bodily formation not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [M 2.0031] kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom the bodily formation will not cease, for them will the mental formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness of beings in the sense-sphere; for those for whom the final sense-sphere consciousness will arise immediately after a certain consciousness; for those in their final existence in the form sphere and the formless sphere; and for those who, having arisen in the form sphere or the formless sphere, will attain Parinibbāna—for them, while passing away, their bodily formation will not cease, but their mental formation will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, their bodily formation will not cease, and their mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the mental formation will not cease, for them will the bodily formation not cease? Yes.

94. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

94. For whom the verbal formation will not cease, for them will the mental formation not cease?

Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa [T 1.0401] bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; and for those for whom the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness—for them, their verbal formation will not cease, but their mental formation will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, their verbal formation will not cease, and their mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever the mental formation will not cease, for them will the verbal formation not cease? Yes.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Adverse Plane

95. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati…pe….

95. Where the bodily formation will not cease… etc….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Adverse Person and Plane

96. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0045] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

96. For whom, where the bodily formation will not cease, for them, there will the verbal formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For persons of the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness of persons of the sense-sphere will arise; and for those in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere—for them, in that plane, their bodily formation will not cease, but their verbal formation will cease. At the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, both the bodily formation will not cease and the verbal formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

Or for whom, where the verbal formation will not cease, for them, there will the bodily formation not cease?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ [M 2.0032] samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them, in that plane, their verbal formation will not cease, but their bodily formation will cease. At the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, both the verbal formation will not cease and the bodily formation will not cease.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0402] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For whom, where the bodily formation will not cease, for them, there will the mental formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For persons of the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness of persons of the sense-sphere will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for those in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere—for them, in that plane, their bodily formation will not cease, but their mental formation will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the bodily formation will not cease and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0046] vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whom, where the mental formation will not cease, for them, there will the bodily formation not cease? Yes.

97. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

97. For whom, where the verbal formation will not cease, for them, there will the mental formation not cease?

Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

At the arising moment of the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; and for those who have attained the second, third, and fourth jhānas—for them, in that plane, their verbal formation will not cease, but their mental formation will cease. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the verbal formation will not cease and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Or for whom, where the mental formation will not cease, for them, there will the verbal formation not cease? Yes.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive Inquiry (Person)

98. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti[T 1.0403]? Āmantā.

98. For one whose bodily formation is ceasing, has his verbal formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for one whose verbal formation has ceased, is his bodily formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, and for non-percipient beings, their verbal formation has ceased, but their bodily formation is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breathing, their verbal formation has ceased and their bodily formation is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

For one whose bodily formation is ceasing, has his mental formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0047] vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for one whose mental formation has ceased, is his bodily formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa [M 2.0033] bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mental formation has ceased, but their bodily formation is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breathing, their mental formation has ceased and their bodily formation is ceasing.

99. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

99. For one whose verbal formation is ceasing, has his mental formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for one whose mental formation has ceased, is his verbal formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness, for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mental formation has ceased, but their verbal formation is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of initial and sustained thought, their mental formation has ceased and their verbal formation is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive Inquiry (Location)

100. Yattha [T 1.0404] kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati…pe….

100. Where bodily formation is ceasing… and so on.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive Inquiry (Person and Location)

101. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti?

101. For a person for whom the bodily formation is ceasing in a certain plane, for that person in that plane has the verbal formation ceased?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, at the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breathing, their bodily formation is ceasing there, but their verbal formation has not ceased there. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those of the sense-sphere, at the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breathing, for them there their bodily formation is ceasing and their verbal formation has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the verbal formation has ceased in a certain plane, for that person in that plane is the bodily formation ceasing?

Paṭhamajjhānaṃ [V 2.0048] samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those of the sense-sphere at the arising-moment of in-and-out breathing; for those same beings at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without in-and-out breathing; and for those of the fine-material sphere and the immaterial sphere—for them, their verbal formation has ceased there, but their bodily formation is not ceasing there. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for those of the sense-sphere, at the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breathing, for them there their verbal formation has ceased and their bodily formation is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom the bodily formation is ceasing in a certain plane, for that person in that plane has the mental formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the mental formation has ceased in a certain plane, for that person in that plane is the bodily formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha[M 2.0034], no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha [T 1.0405] kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness, and for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without in-and-out breathing, for them their mental formation has ceased there, but their bodily formation is not ceasing there. At the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breathing, for them there their mental formation has ceased and their bodily formation is ceasing.

102. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

102. For a person for whom the verbal formation is ceasing in a certain plane, for that person in that plane has the mental formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom the mental formation has ceased in a certain plane, for that person in that plane is the verbal formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness, and for those at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for them their mental formation has ceased there, but their verbal formation is not ceasing there. At the dissolution-moment of initial and sustained thought, for them there their mental formation has ceased and their verbal formation is ceasing.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative Inquiry (Person)

103. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

103. For one whose bodily formation is not ceasing, has his verbal formation not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0049] vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or, for one whose verbal formation has not ceased, is his bodily formation not ceasing? There is no such being.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

For one whose bodily formation is not ceasing, has his mental formation not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or, for one whose mental formation has not ceased, is his bodily formation not ceasing? There is no such being.

104. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

104. For one whose verbal formation is not ceasing, has his mental formation not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

Or, for one whose mental formation has not ceased, is his verbal formation not ceasing? There is no such being.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

105. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati…pe….
