(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(f) Negative Inquiry (Person and Location)

106. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti?

106. For a person for whom the bodily formation is not ceasing in a certain plane, for that person in that plane has the verbal formation not ceased?

Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ [T 1.0406] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha. Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ [M 2.0035] uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha.

For those who have attained the first jhāna; for sense-sphere beings at the arising moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those same beings at the dissolution moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for beings of the form-plane and the formless-plane—for them, in that plane, the bodily formation is not ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the verbal formation did cease. For those who have attained the second and third jhānas; for those at the arising moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those same beings at the dissolution moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; for beings of the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring; and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the verbal formation did not cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0050] vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

Or, for one for whom, in whatever plane the verbal formation did not cease, for them, in that plane, does the bodily formation not cease?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ suddhāvāsānaṃ dutiye citte vattamāne asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those who have attained the second and third jhānas at the dissolution moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the verbal formation did not cease, but for them, in that plane, the bodily formation is ceasing. For those who have attained the second and third jhānas; for those at the arising moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those same beings at the dissolution moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; for beings of the Pure Abodes when the second consciousness is occurring; and for non-percipient beings—for them, in that plane, both the verbal formation did not cease and the bodily formation does not cease.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti?

For one for whom, in a certain plane, the bodily formation does not cease, for them, in that plane, did the mental formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro [T 1.0407] ca na nirujjhittha.

For all at the arising moment of consciousness, and at the dissolution moment of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the bodily formation does not cease, but for them, in that plane, the mental formation did cease. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the bodily formation does not cease and the mental formation did not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or, for one for whom, in whatever plane the mental formation did not cease, for them, in that plane, does the bodily formation not cease? Yes.

107. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti?

107. For one for whom, in a certain plane, the verbal formation does not cease, for them, in that plane, did the mental formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha. Suddhāvāsaṃ upapajjantānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha.

For all at the arising moment of consciousness, and at the dissolution moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought, for them, in that plane, the verbal formation does not cease, but for them, in that plane, the mental formation did cease. For those being reborn in the Pure Abodes and for non-percipient beings, for them, in that plane, both the verbal formation does not cease and the mental formation did not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or, for one for whom, in whatever plane the mental formation did not cease, for them, in that plane, does the verbal formation not cease? Yes.

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

(5) The Present and Future Section

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) The Positive Person

108. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0051] kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For one whose bodily formation is ceasing, will their verbal formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti[M 2.0036]?

Or, for one whose verbal formation will cease, is their bodily formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

108. For all at the arising-moment of consciousness; at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without in-and-out breaths; for those who have attained the attainment of cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the verbal formation will cease, but their bodily formation is not ceasing. At the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breaths, for them, both their verbal formation will cease and their bodily formation is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For one whose bodily formation is ceasing, will their mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for one whose mental formation will cease, is their bodily formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā [T 1.0408] assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness; at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without in-and-out breaths; for those who have attained the attainment of cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the mental formation will cease, but their bodily formation is not ceasing. At the dissolution-moment of in-and-out breaths, for them, both their mental formation will cease and their bodily formation is ceasing.

109. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

For one whose verbal formation is ceasing, will their mental formation cease?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

At the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought, for them, their verbal formation is ceasing, but their mental formation will not cease. For others, at the dissolution-moment of applied and sustained thought, for them, both their verbal formation is ceasing and their mental formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0052] vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

109. Or, for one whose mental formation will cease, is their verbal formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all at the arising-moment of consciousness; at the dissolution-moment of consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those who have attained the attainment of cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the mental formation will cease, but their verbal formation is not ceasing. At the dissolution-moment of applied and sustained thought, for them, both their mental formation will cease and their verbal formation is ceasing.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Positive Plane

110. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati…pe….

Where the bodily formation is ceasing... etc....

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) The Positive Person-Plane

111. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

(a) For a person for whom, in a certain plane, the bodily formation is ceasing, for that person, in that plane, will the verbal formation cease?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro [T 1.0409] ca nirujjhissati.

For those who have entered the second jhāna and the third jhāna, at the moment of dissolution of their in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the bodily formation is ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the verbal formation will not cease. For those who have entered the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings, at the moment of dissolution of their in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the bodily formation is ceasing and the verbal formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa [M 2.0037] tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom, in a certain plane, the verbal formation will cease, for that person, in that plane, is the bodily formation ceasing?

Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For those who have entered the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings at the moment of arising of their in-breaths and out-breaths; for those very same beings at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; and for fine-material-sphere and immaterial-sphere beings—for them, in that plane, the verbal formation will cease, but for them, in that plane, the bodily formation is not ceasing. For those who have entered the first jhāna and for sense-sphere beings, at the moment of dissolution of their in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the verbal formation will cease and the bodily formation is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0053] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

For a person for whom, in a certain plane, the bodily formation is ceasing, for that person, in that plane, will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom, in a certain plane, the mental formation will cease, for that person, in that plane, is the bodily formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all beings at the moment of arising of consciousness, and at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the mental formation will cease, but for them, in that plane, the bodily formation is not ceasing. At the moment of dissolution of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, in that plane, the mental formation will cease and the bodily formation is ceasing.

112. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

112. For a person for whom, in a certain plane, the verbal formation is ceasing, for that person, in that plane, will the mental formation cease?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness with initial and sustained thought, for them, in that plane, the verbal formation is ceasing, but for them, in that plane, the mental formation will not cease. For the others, at the moment of dissolution of initial and sustained thought, for them, in that plane, the verbal formation is ceasing and the mental formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha [T 1.0410] cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

Or, for a person for whom, in a certain plane, the mental formation will cease, for that person, in that plane, is the verbal formation ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati. Vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhati.

For all beings at the moment of arising of consciousness, and at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for them, in that plane, the mental formation will cease, but for them, in that plane, the verbal formation is not ceasing. At the moment of dissolution of initial and sustained thought, for them, in that plane, the mental formation will cease and the verbal formation is ceasing.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative Person

113. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the bodily formation is not ceasing, for that one, will the verbal formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati [V 2.0054] tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro [M 2.0038] ca na nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

113. For all beings at the moment of arising of consciousness; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them the bodily formation is not ceasing, but their verbal formation will cease. For those at the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness with initial and sustained thought; for those endowed with a final consciousness without initial and sustained thought; and for those for whom a final consciousness without initial and sustained thought will arise immediately after a certain consciousness—for them both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the verbal formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Or again, for one for whom the verbal formation will not cease, for that one, is the bodily formation not ceasing? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the bodily formation is not ceasing, for that one, will the mental formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For all beings at the moment of arising of consciousness; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them the bodily formation is not ceasing, but their mental formation will cease. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness, for them both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or again, for one for whom…pe…? Yes.

114. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0411] vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For one for whom the verbal formation is not ceasing, for that one, will the mental formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

114. For all beings at the moment of arising of consciousness; for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without initial and sustained thought; for those who have attained cessation; and for non-percipient beings—for them the verbal formation is not ceasing, but their mental formation will cease. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for them both the verbal formation is not ceasing and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

Or again, for one for whom the mental formation will not cease, for that one, is the verbal formation not ceasing?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness with initial and sustained thought, for them the mental formation will not cease, but their verbal formation is ceasing. At the moment of dissolution of the final consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for them both the mental formation will not cease and the verbal formation is not ceasing.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(Ṅa) The Negative Plane

115. Yattha [V 2.0055] kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati…pe….

115. Where the bodily formation does not cease…pe….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative Person-Plane

116. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomsoever in whatsoever plane the bodily formation is not ceasing, for that one in that plane will the verbal formation not cease?

Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ [M 2.0039] pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ [T 1.0412] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those sense-sphere beings who have attained the first jhāna, existing at the arising-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, and for those in the form sphere and formless sphere, for them in that plane the bodily formation is not ceasing, but for them in that plane the verbal formation will cease. For those existing at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the second and third jhāna; for those same persons existing at the arising-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths; for those persons existing at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, apart from in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them in that plane, both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the verbal formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

Or for whomsoever in whatsoever plane the verbal formation will not cease, for him in that plane is the bodily formation not ceasing?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃyeva vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, existing at the dissolution-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them in that plane the verbal formation will not cease, but for them in that plane the bodily formation is ceasing. For those existing at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, existing at the arising-moment of in-breaths and out-breaths; for those persons existing at the dissolution-moment of consciousness, apart from in-breaths and out-breaths; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them in that plane, both the verbal formation will not cease and the bodily formation is not ceasing.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0056] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For whomsoever in whatsoever plane the bodily formation is not ceasing, for him in that plane will the mental formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For all beings existing at the arising-moment of consciousness, and for those existing at the dissolution-moment of consciousness apart from in-breaths and out-breaths, for them in that plane the bodily formation is not ceasing, but for them in that plane the mental formation will cease. For those existing at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane both the bodily formation is not ceasing and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for whomsoever in whatsoever plane the mental formation will not cease, for him in that plane is the bodily formation not ceasing? Yes.

117. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro [T 1.0413] na nirujjhissatīti?

117. For whomsoever in whatsoever plane the verbal formation is not ceasing, for him in that plane will the mental formation not cease?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For all beings existing at the arising-moment of consciousness, and for those existing at the dissolution-moment of consciousness apart from applied and sustained thought, for them in that plane the verbal formation is not ceasing, but for them in that plane the mental formation will cease. For those existing at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane both the verbal formation is not ceasing and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

Or for whomsoever in whatsoever plane the mental formation will not cease, for him in that plane is the verbal formation not ceasing?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Avitakkaavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

For those existing at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought, for them in that plane the mental formation will not cease, but for them in that plane the verbal formation is ceasing. For those existing at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane both the mental formation will not cease and the verbal formation is not ceasing.

(6) Atītānāgatavāro

(6) The Section on the Past and Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(Ka) Positive: Person

118. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0040] kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

118. For a person for whom the bodily formation has ceased, will the verbal formation cease for that person?

Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ [V 2.0057] yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those who are at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; and for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise—for them, the bodily formation has ceased, but for them the verbal formation will not cease. For the other persons, both the bodily formation has ceased and the verbal formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person for whom the verbal formation will cease, for that person has the bodily formation ceased? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

For a person for whom the bodily formation has ceased, will the mental formation cease for that person?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha [T 1.0414] cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, for them the bodily formation has ceased, but for them the mental formation will not cease. For the other persons, for them both the bodily formation has ceased and the mental formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person for whom the mental formation will cease, for that person has the bodily formation ceased? Yes.

119. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

119. For a person for whom the verbal formation has ceased, will the mental formation cease for that person?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, for them the verbal formation has ceased, but for them the mental formation will not cease. For the other persons, for them both the verbal formation has ceased and the mental formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person for whom the mental formation will cease, for that person has the verbal formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) Positive: The Plane

120. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha…pe….

120. Where the bodily formation has ceased…pe….

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(Ga) Positive: Person and Plane

121. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

121. For a person for whom the bodily formation has ceased in a certain plane, will the verbal formation cease for that person in that plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness in the sense-sphere plane, and for those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them in that plane the bodily formation has ceased, but for them in that plane the verbal formation will not cease. For those who have attained the first jhāna, and for the other beings of the sense-sphere plane, for them in that plane the bodily formation has not ceased, and the verbal formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti?

Or for a person for whom the verbal formation will cease in a certain plane, has the bodily formation ceased for that person in that plane?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ [V 2.0058] arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ [M 2.0041] samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha.

For beings of the form sphere and beings of the formless sphere, for them in that plane the verbal formation will cease, but for them in that plane the bodily formation has not ceased. For sense-sphere beings who have attained the first jhāna, for them in that plane both the verbal formation will cease and the bodily formation has ceased.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha [T 1.0415] tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

For a person for whom the bodily formation has ceased in a certain plane, will the mental formation cease for that person in that plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness in the sense-sphere, for them the bodily formation has ceased there, but for them the mental formation will not cease there. For those who have attained the first, second, and third jhānas, and for the other beings of the sense-sphere, for them in that plane both the bodily formation has ceased and the mental formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti?

Or for a person for whom the mental formation will cease in a certain plane, has the bodily formation ceased for that person in that plane?

Catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nirujjhittha. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha.

For those who have attained the fourth jhāna, for beings of the form sphere, and for beings of the formless sphere, for them in that plane the mental formation will cease, but for them in that plane the bodily formation has not ceased. For sense-sphere beings who have attained the first, second, and third jhānas, for them in that plane both the mental formation will cease and the bodily formation has ceased.

122. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

122. For a person for whom the verbal formation has ceased in a certain plane, will the mental formation cease for that person in that plane?

Savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness in the plane with initial and sustained thought, for them in that plane the verbal formation has ceased, but for them in that plane the mental formation will not cease. For the other persons in the plane with initial and sustained thought, for them in that plane both the verbal formation has ceased and the mental formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti?

Or for a person for whom the mental formation will cease in a certain plane, has the verbal formation ceased for that person in that plane?

Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha. Savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha.

For those in the plane without initial and sustained thought, for them in that plane the mental formation will cease, but for them in that plane the verbal formation has not ceased. For those in the plane with initial and sustained thought, for them in that plane both the mental formation will cease and the verbal formation has ceased.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative: The Person

123. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0059] kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

123. For a person for whom the bodily formation has not ceased, will the verbal formation not cease for them? There is no such being.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or, for a person for whom the verbal formation will not cease, has the bodily formation not ceased for them? It has ceased.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

For a person for whom the bodily formation has not ceased, will the mental formation not cease for them? There is no such being.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or, for a person for whom the mental formation will not cease, has the bodily formation not ceased for them? It has ceased.

124. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0416][M 2.0042] vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

124. For a person for whom the verbal formation has not ceased, will the mental formation not cease for them? There is no such being.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

Or, for a person for whom the mental formation will not cease, has the verbal formation not ceased for them? It has ceased.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(e) Negative: The Plane

125. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha…pe….

125. Where the bodily formation has not ceased…pe….

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(f) Negative: Person and Plane

126. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

126. For a person for whom in a certain plane the bodily formation has not ceased, will the verbal formation not cease for them in that plane?

Rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ [V 2.0060] pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For form-sphere beings and formless-sphere beings, for them the bodily formation has not ceased in that plane, but the verbal formation will cease for them there. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with initial and sustained thought in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere; for those endowed with a final consciousness without initial and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, a final consciousness without initial and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them in that plane both the bodily formation has not ceased and the verbal formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti?

Or, for a person for whom in a certain plane the verbal formation will not cease, has the bodily formation not ceased for them in that plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the sense-sphere, and for those who have attained the second and third jhānas, for them the verbal formation will not cease in that plane, but the bodily formation has ceased for them there. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness with initial and sustained thought in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere; for those endowed with a final consciousness without initial and sustained thought; for those for whom, immediately after a certain consciousness, a final consciousness without initial and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them in that plane both the verbal formation will not cease and the bodily formation has not ceased.

(Ka) yassa [T 1.0417] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For a person for whom in a certain plane the bodily formation has not ceased, will the mental formation not cease for them in that plane?

Catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those who have attained the fourth jhāna, for form-sphere beings, and for formless-sphere beings, for them the bodily formation has not ceased in that plane, but the mental formation will cease for them there. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane both the bodily formation has not ceased and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti?

Or, for a person for whom in a certain plane the mental formation will not cease, has the bodily formation not ceased for them in that plane?

Kāmāvacare pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro [M 2.0043] na nirujjhittha. Rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the sense-sphere, for them the mental formation will not cease there, but the bodily formation has ceased for them there. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane, the mental formation will not cease, and the bodily formation has not ceased.

127. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

127. (a) For a person for whom in a certain plane the verbal formation has not ceased, for that person will the mental formation not cease in that plane?

Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ [V 2.0061] tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the plane without initial and sustained thought, for them the verbal formation has not ceased there, but the mental formation will cease for them there. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the plane without initial and sustained thought, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane, the verbal formation has not ceased, and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhitthāti?

(b) Or, for a person for whom in a certain plane the mental formation will not cease, for that person has the verbal formation not ceased in that plane?

Savitakkasavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhittha. Avitakkaavicārabhūmiyaṃ pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ [T 1.0418] tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhittha.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the plane with initial and sustained thought, for them the mental formation will not cease there, but the verbal formation has ceased for them there. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final consciousness in the plane without initial and sustained thought, and for non-percipient beings, for them in that plane, the mental formation will not cease, and the verbal formation has not ceased.

Nirodhavāro.

The Section on Cessation.

2. Pavatti 3. uppādanirodhavāro

2. Formations, Occurrence: The Section on Arising and Ceasing.

(1) Paccuppannavāro

(1) The Section on the Present

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: The Person

128. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti? No.

128. For a person for whom the bodily formation is arising, for that person is the verbal formation ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti? No.

Or for a person for whom the verbal formation is ceasing, for that person is the bodily formation arising? No.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti? No.

For a person for whom the bodily formation is arising, for that person is the mental formation ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti? No.

Or for a person for whom the mental formation is ceasing, for that person is the bodily formation arising? No.

129. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti? No.

129. For a person for whom the verbal formation is arising, for that person is the mental formation ceasing? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? No.

Or for a person for whom the mental formation is ceasing, for that person is the verbal formation arising? No.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive: The Plane

130. Yattha [M 2.0044][V 2.0062] kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

130. In whichever plane the bodily formation is arising, in that plane is the verbal formation ceasing?

Dutiyajjhāne tatiyajjhāne tattha…pe… (itaresaṃ yatthakānaṃ sadisaṃ).

In the second jhāna and in the third jhāna, in that plane... [abbreviated]... (The analysis is similar to the other sections concerning planes).

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive: The Person and the Plane

131. Yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati…pe… (yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ).

131. For a person for whom, in a plane in which, the bodily formation is arising... [abbreviated]... (It is similar to both the section on the person and the section on the person and plane).

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative: The Person

132. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

132. For a person for whom the bodily formation is not arising, for that person is the verbal formation not ceasing?

Vitakkavicārānaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

At the moment of dissolution of initial and sustained thought, for those persons the bodily formation is not arising, but for them the verbal formation is ceasing. For those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them, the bodily formation is not arising, and the verbal formation is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa [T 1.0419] kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Or for a person for whom the verbal formation is not ceasing, for that person is the bodily formation not arising?

Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for those persons the verbal formation is not ceasing, but for them the bodily formation is arising. For those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those at the moment of dissolution of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them, the verbal formation is not ceasing, and the bodily formation is not arising.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhatīti?

For a person for whom the bodily formation is not arising, for that person is the mental formation not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe [V 2.0063] nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

At the moment of dissolution of consciousness of all beings, for them the bodily formation is not arising, but for them the mental formation is ceasing. For those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them, the bodily formation is not arising, and the mental formation is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Or for a person for whom the mental formation is not ceasing, for that person is the bodily formation not arising?

Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the moment of arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for those persons the mental formation is not ceasing, but for them the bodily formation is arising. For those at the moment of arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them, the mental formation is not ceasing, and the bodily formation is not arising.

133. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0045] vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhatīti?

133. For a person for whom the verbal formation is not arising, for that person is the mental formation not ceasing?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati. Vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati.

At the moment of dissolution of consciousness of all beings, for them the verbal formation is not arising, but for them the mental formation is ceasing. For those at the moment of arising of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them, the verbal formation is not arising, and the mental formation is not ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro [T 1.0420] na nirujjhati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjatīti?

Or for a person for whom the mental formation is not ceasing, for that person is the verbal formation not arising?

Vitakkavicārānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjati. Vinā vitakkavicārehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjati.

At the moment of arising of initial and sustained thought, for those persons the mental formation is not ceasing, but for them the verbal formation is arising. For those at the moment of arising of consciousness without initial and sustained thought, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, for them, the mental formation is not ceasing, and the verbal formation is not arising.

(Ṅa) paccanīkaokāso

(e) Negative: The Plane

134. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati…pe….

134. In the plane where the bodily formation does not arise… [abbreviated]…

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(f) Negative: The Person and the Plane

135. Yassa [V 2.0064] yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjati…pe….

135. For a person for whom, in a plane where, the bodily formation does not arise… [abbreviated]…

(Yassakampi yassayatthakampi sadisaṃ, yassayatthake nirodhasamāpannānanti na labbhati).

(The section on the person and the section on the person and plane are similar, but in the section on the person and plane, the case of 'those who have attained the attainment of cessation' is not applicable.)

(2) Atītavāro

(2) The Section on the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: The Person

136. Yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjittha tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

136. For whomever the bodily formation arose, for that person did the verbal formation cease? Yes.

(Atītā pucchā uppādavārepi nirodhavārepi uppādanirodhavārepi sadisaṃ vitthāretabbā).

(The past question should be elaborated similarly in the section on arising, the section on ceasing, and the section on arising and ceasing.)

(3) Anāgatavāro

(3) The Section on the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive: The Person

137. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

137. (a) For whomever the bodily formation will arise, for that person will the verbal formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(b) Or for whomever the verbal formation will cease, for that person will the bodily formation arise?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa [M 2.0046] anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati[T 1.0421]. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those sense-sphere beings at the arising-moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings will arise, for those in their final existence in the form sphere and the formless sphere, and for those who, having arisen in the form sphere or the formless sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, while they are passing away—for them the verbal formation will cease, but the bodily formation will not arise. For the others, both their verbal formation will cease and their bodily formation will arise.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0065] kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever the bodily formation will arise, for that person will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(b) Or for whomever the mental formation will cease, for that person will the bodily formation arise?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those sense-sphere beings at the arising-moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings will arise, for those in their final existence in the form sphere and the formless sphere, and for those who, having arisen in the form sphere or the formless sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, while they are passing away—for them the mental formation will cease, but the bodily formation will not arise. For the others, both their mental formation will cease and their bodily formation will arise.

138. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

138. (a) For whomever the verbal formation will arise, for that person will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(b) Or for whomever the mental formation will cease, for that person will the verbal formation arise?

Pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those at the arising-moment of the final consciousness, and for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied thought and sustained thought will arise—for them the mental formation will cease, but the verbal formation will not arise. For the others, both their mental formation will cease and their verbal formation will arise.

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(b) Positive: The Plane

139. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati…pe….

139. In which plane the bodily formation will arise... and so on.

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Positive: The Person and Plane

140. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti?

140. (a) For whomever, in whatever plane, the bodily formation will arise, for that person, in that plane, will the verbal formation cease?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ [T 1.0422] tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them the bodily formation will arise in that plane, but for them the verbal formation will not cease in that plane. For those in the sense-sphere who have attained the first jhāna, for them in that plane both the bodily formation will arise and the verbal formation will cease.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0066] vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(b) Or, for whomever, in whatever plane, the verbal formation will cease, for that person, in that plane, will the bodily formation arise?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa [M 2.0047] uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For sense-sphere beings at the arising-moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings will arise, for form-sphere beings, and for formless-sphere beings—for them, in that plane, the verbal formation will cease, but for them, in that plane, the bodily formation will not arise. For those who have attained the first jhāna and for the other sense-sphere beings, for them, in that plane, both the verbal formation will cease and the bodily formation will arise.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

(a) For whomever, in whatever plane, the bodily formation will arise, for that person, in that plane, will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(b) Or, for whomever, in whatever plane, the mental formation will cease, for that person, in that plane, will the bodily formation arise?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ itaresaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For sense-sphere beings at the arising-moment of the final consciousness, for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings will arise, for those who have attained the fourth jhāna, for form-sphere beings, and for formless-sphere beings—for them, in that plane, the mental formation will cease, but for them, in that plane, the bodily formation will not arise. For those who have attained the first, second, and third jhānas, and for the other sense-sphere beings, for them, in that plane, both the mental formation will cease and the bodily formation will arise.

141. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro [T 1.0423] nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

141. (a) For whomever, in whatever plane, the verbal formation will arise, for that person, in that plane, will the mental formation cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissatīti?

(b) Or, for whomever, in whatever plane, the mental formation will cease, for that person, in that plane, will the verbal formation arise?

Pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro uppajjissati. Paṭhamajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ kāmāvacarānaṃ [V 2.0067] itaresaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro ca nirujjhissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca uppajjissati.

For those at the arising-moment of the final consciousness; for those after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; and for those who have attained the second, third, and fourth jhānas—for them, in that plane, the mental formation will cease, but for them, in that plane, the verbal formation will not arise. For those who have attained the first jhāna, and for the other sense-sphere beings, form-sphere beings, and formless-sphere beings, for them, in that plane, both the mental formation will cease and the verbal formation will arise.

(Gha) paccanīkapuggalo

(d) Negative: The Person

142. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

142. (a) For whomever the bodily formation will not arise, for that person will the verbal formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ [M 2.0048] uppajjissati tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness of those in the sense-sphere will arise; for final-existence beings in the fine-material and immaterial spheres; and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, as they are passing away—for them the bodily formation will not arise, but for them the verbal formation will cease. At the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; and for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise—for them the bodily formation will not arise and the verbal formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person for whom, on the other hand... and so on...? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For a person for whom the bodily formation will not arise, for them will the mental formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa [T 1.0424] anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacare arūpāvacare pacchimabhavikānaṃ ye ca rūpāvacaraṃ arūpāvacaraṃ upapajjitvā parinibbāyissanti tesaṃ cavantānaṃ tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those in the sense-sphere at the arising moment of the final consciousness; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness of those in the sense-sphere will arise; for final-existence beings in the fine-material and immaterial spheres; and for those who, having been reborn in the fine-material or immaterial sphere, will attain Parinibbāna, as they are passing away—for them the bodily formation will not arise, but for them the mental formation will cease. At the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, for them the bodily formation will not arise and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person for whom, on the other hand... and so on...? Yes.

143. (Ka) yassa vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

143. For a person for whom the verbal formation will not arise, for them will the mental formation not cease?

Pacchimacittassa [V 2.0068] uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

At the arising moment of the final consciousness; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise—for them the verbal formation will not arise, but for them the mental formation will cease. At the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, for them the verbal formation will not arise and the mental formation will not cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā.

144. Yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati…pe….

144. Where the bodily formation will not arise... and so on.

(Ca) paccanīkapuggalokāsā

(Ca) The Negative: Person and Plane

145. (Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

145. For a person in a plane where the bodily formation will not arise, for that person in that plane will the verbal formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa [T 1.0425] anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings will arise; and for those in the fine-material sphere and formless sphere—for them, the bodily formation will not arise there, but for them the verbal formation will cease there. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the bodily formation will not arise there and the verbal formation will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati tassa tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissatīti?

Or for a person in a plane where the verbal formation will not cease, for that person in that plane will the bodily formation not arise?

Dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati. Savitakkasavicārapacchimacittassa [M 2.0049] bhaṅgakkhaṇe avitakkaavicārapacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati [V 2.0069] catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati.

For those who have attained the second jhāna and the third jhāna, for them the verbal formation will not cease there, but for them the bodily formation will arise there. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness with applied and sustained thought; for those endowed with the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for non-percipient beings—for them, the verbal formation will not cease there and the bodily formation will not arise there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

For a person in a plane where the bodily formation will not arise, for that person in that plane will the mental formation not cease?

Kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe yassa cittassa anantarā kāmāvacarānaṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ rūpāvacarānaṃ arūpāvacarānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha kāyasaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness of sense-sphere beings will arise; for those who have attained the fourth jhāna; and for those in the fine-material sphere and formless sphere—for them, the bodily formation will not arise there, but for them the mental formation will cease there. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them the bodily formation will not arise there and the mental formation will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person in a plane where... and so on...? Yes.

146. (Ka) yassa yattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati tassa tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissatīti?

146. For a person in a plane where the verbal formation will not arise, for that person in that plane will the mental formation not cease?

Pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe [T 1.0426] yassa cittassa anantarā avitakkaavicāraṃ pacchimacittaṃ uppajjissati dutiyajjhānaṃ tatiyajjhānaṃ catutthajjhānaṃ samāpannānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro nuppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ tattha cittasaṅkhāro na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ tattha vacīsaṅkhāro ca nuppajjissati cittasaṅkhāro ca na nirujjhissati.

For those at the arising moment of the final consciousness; for those immediately after whose consciousness the final consciousness without applied and sustained thought will arise; and for those who have attained the second, third, and fourth jhānas—for them, the verbal formation will not arise there, but for them the mental formation will cease there. For those at the dissolution moment of the final consciousness, and for non-percipient beings, for them the verbal formation will not arise there and the mental formation will not cease there.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha…pe…? Āmantā.

Or for a person in a plane where... and so on...? Yes.

(4) Paccuppannātītavāro

(4) The Section on the Present and the Past

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(A) Positive Inquiry: Person

147. (Ka) yassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati tassa vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

147. For one whose bodily formation is arising, has their verbal formation ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

Or, for one whose verbal formation has ceased, is their bodily formation arising?

Sabbesaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe vinā assāsapassāsehi cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhittha[V 2.0070], no ca tesaṃ kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjati. Assāsapassāsānaṃ uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ vacīsaṅkhāro ca nirujjhittha kāyasaṅkhāro ca uppajjati.

For all beings at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, their verbal formation has ceased, but their bodily formation is not arising. At the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, their verbal formation has ceased and their bodily formation is arising.

(Yathā [M 2.0050] uppādavāre paccuppannātītā pucchā anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhattā evaṃ uppādavāranirodhavārepi paccuppannātītā pucchā anulomampi paccanīkampi vibhajitabbā.)

Just as in the Arising Section the questions on the present and past were analyzed in both the positive and negative order, so too in the Arising-Cessation Section the questions on the present and past should be analyzed in both the positive and negative order.

(5) Paccuppannānāgatavāro

(5) The Section on the Present and the Future

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(A) Positive Inquiry: Person

(Kha) yassa vā pana vacīsaṅkhāro nirujjhissati tassa kāyasaṅkhāro uppajjatīti?

For all beings at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, their verbal formation will cease, but their bodily formation is not arising. At the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, their verbal formation will cease and their bodily formation is arising.

For all beings at the moment of the dissolution of consciousness, for those at the moment of the arising of consciousness without in-breaths and out-breaths, for those who have attained cessation, and for non-percipient beings—for them, their mental formation will cease, but their bodily formation is not arising. At the moment of the arising of in-breaths and out-breaths, for them, their mental formation will cease and their bodily formation is arising.

149. (A) For one whose verbal formation is arising, will his mental formation cease? Yes.
