Dukkhāya vedanāya ettha [T 1.0452] avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca [V 2.0094] anusenti, no ca tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti. (Chakkamūlakaṃ)

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the underlying tendency to ignorance, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, the underlying tendency to doubt, and the underlying tendency to craving for becoming lie latent here, but the underlying tendency to sensual desire and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie latent there. In the desire-sphere, in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendency to ignorance, the underlying tendency to sensual desire, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt lie latent here, but the underlying tendency to aversion and the underlying tendency to craving for becoming do not lie latent there. In regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to ignorance, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt lie latent here, but the underlying tendency to sensual desire, the underlying tendency to conceit, and the underlying tendency to craving for becoming do not lie latent there. (The Hexad as Root)

(Ga) anulomapuggalokāsā

(c) Forward Order: Person and Sphere

25. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha paṭighānusayo anusetīti? No.

25. (a) For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to aversion also lie latent for him there? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha paṭighānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo anusetīti? No.

(b) Or again, for one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire also lie latent for him there? No.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha mānānusayo anusetīti? Āmantā.

(a) For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to conceit also lie latent for him there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha mānānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo anusetīti?

(b) Or again, for one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire also lie latent for him there?

Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha mānānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti. Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo anuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo ca anuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca anuseti.

For a non-returner, in the desire-sphere, in regard to two feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, for him the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent there, but the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not lie latent for him there. For the three persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent there, but the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the desire-sphere, in regard to two feelings, for them both the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to sensual desire lie latent there.

Yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo anusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to views... pe... the underlying tendency to doubt lie latent for him there?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti. Puthujjanassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca anuseti vicikicchānusayo ca anuseti.

For two persons, in the desire-sphere, in regard to two feelings, for them the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent there, but the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent for them there. For a worldling, in the desire-sphere, in regard to two feelings, for him both the underlying tendency to sensual desire and the underlying tendency to doubt lie latent there.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo [T 1.0453] anusetīti?

Or again, for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to sensual desire lie latent for him there?

Puthujjanassa [V 2.0095] dukkhāya vedanāya [M 2.0069] rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca anuseti kāmārāgānusayo ca anuseti.

For a worldling, in regard to painful feeling, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, for him the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent there, but the underlying tendency to sensual desire does not lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the desire-sphere, in regard to two feelings, for him both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to sensual desire lie latent there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo anusetīti? No.

(a) For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to craving for becoming lie latent for him there? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo anusetīti? No.

(a) For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual desire lies latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to ignorance lie latent for him there? Yes.

For those very persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to lust for being lie latent therein. (Single-rooted section)

31. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha mānānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

31. (a) For any person in whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent in any plane, for that person, does the underlying tendency to conceit lie latent in that plane? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha mānānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusentīti?

(b) Or again, for any person in whom the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent in any plane, for that person, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent in that plane?

Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha mānānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo anuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti.

For a non-returner, in the sense-sphere, in two feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, for that person the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent therein, but for that person both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie latent therein. For three persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for them the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent therein, but for them both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie latent therein. For those very persons, in the sense-sphere, in two feelings, for them both the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to sensual lust lie latent therein, but for them the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent therein.

Yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

(a) For any person in whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent in any plane, for that person, does the underlying tendency to doubt lie latent in that plane? No.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo [T 1.0458] ca paṭighānusayo ca anusentīti?

(b) Or again, for any person in whom the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent in any plane, for that person, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent in that plane?

Puthujjanassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo [V 2.0100] ca kāmarāgānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti[M 2.0073]. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti.

For a worldling, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, for that person the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent therein, but for that person both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie latent therein. For that very person, in the sense-sphere, in two feelings, for that person both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to sensual lust lie latent therein, but for that person the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent therein. For that very person, with respect to painful feeling, for that person both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent therein, but for that person the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent therein.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

(a) For any person in whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion lie latent in any plane, for that person, does the underlying tendency to lust for being lie latent in that plane? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusentīti? No.

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of lust for existence lies latent, for that person, there, do both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion lie latent? No.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

For whomever, wherever both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of ignorance lie latent? It is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusentīti?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent, for that person, there, do both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion lie latent?

Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo anuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ [T 1.0459] tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo anuseti. (Dukamūlakaṃ)

For a non-returner, in the sense-sphere, in the three feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent for him there, but both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion do not lie latent for him there. For the three persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent for them there, but both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion do not lie latent for them there. For those very same persons, in the sense-sphere, in two feelings, both the latent tendency of ignorance and the latent tendency of sensual lust lie latent for them there, but the latent tendency of aversion does not lie latent for them there. For those very same persons, in painful feeling, both the latent tendency of ignorance and the latent tendency of aversion lie latent for them there, but the latent tendency of sensual lust does not lie latent for them there. (Rooted in the Dyad)

32. Yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

32. For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of views... does the latent tendency of skeptical doubt lie latent? It is not.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusentīti?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of skeptical doubt lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit lie latent?

Puthujjanassa [V 2.0101] rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha [M 2.0074] vicikicchānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti.

For a worldling, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, both the latent tendency of skeptical doubt and the latent tendency of conceit lie latent for him there, but both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion do not lie latent for him there. For that very same person, in the sense-sphere, in two feelings, the latent tendencies of skeptical doubt, sensual lust, and conceit lie latent for him there, but the latent tendency of aversion does not lie latent for him there. For that very same person, in painful feeling, both the latent tendency of skeptical doubt and the latent tendency of aversion lie latent for him there, but both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of conceit do not lie latent for him there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of lust for existence lie latent? It is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusentīti[T 1.0460]?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of lust for existence lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit lie latent?

Catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti.

For the four persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, both the latent tendency of lust for existence and the latent tendency of conceit lie latent for them there, but both the latent tendency of sensual lust and the latent tendency of aversion do not lie latent for them there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of ignorance lie latent? It is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusentīti?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit lie latent?

Anāgāmissa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha avijjānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā [V 2.0102] dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo [T 1.0461] ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti. (Tikamūlakaṃ)

For a non-returner, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent for that person there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit do not lie latent for that person there. For that same person, in the sense-sphere in regard to two feelings, and in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the latent tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent for that person there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and aversion do not lie latent for that person there. For the three persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the latent tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent for them there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and aversion do not lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the sense-sphere in regard to two feelings, the latent tendencies of ignorance, sensual lust, and conceit lie latent for them there, but the latent tendency of aversion does not lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies of ignorance and aversion lie latent for them there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and conceit do not lie latent for them there. (Rooted in the Triad)

33. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

33. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of skeptical doubt lie latent? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo [M 2.0075] ca anusentīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of skeptical doubt lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views lie latent?

Puthujjanassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti.

For a worldling, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the latent tendencies of skeptical doubt, conceit, and views lie latent for that person there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and aversion do not lie latent for that person there. For that same person, in the sense-sphere in regard to two feelings, the latent tendencies of skeptical doubt, sensual lust, conceit, and views lie latent for that person there, but the latent tendency of aversion does not lie latent for that person there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies of skeptical doubt, aversion, and views lie latent for that person there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and conceit do not lie latent for that person there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of craving for existence also lie latent? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusentīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of craving for existence lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views also lie latent?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo [T 1.0462] ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti. Puthujjanassa [V 2.0103] rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti.

For the three persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the latent tendencies of craving for existence and conceit lie latent for them there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and views do not lie latent for them there. For an ordinary person, in the form realm and the formless realm, the latent tendencies of craving for existence, conceit, and views lie latent for that person there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and aversion do not lie latent for that person there.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of ignorance also lie latent? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusentīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views also lie latent?

Anāgāmissa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha avijjānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ [M 2.0076] tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva [T 1.0463] puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti. Puthujjanassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca anusenti[V 2.0104], no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti. (Catukkamūlakaṃ)

For a non-returner, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the desire realm, in regard to two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the latent tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and views do not lie latent there. For two persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the latent tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and views do not lie latent there. For those same persons, in the desire realm, in regard to two feelings, the latent tendencies of ignorance, sensual lust, and conceit lie latent there, but the latent tendencies of aversion and views do not lie latent there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies of ignorance and aversion lie latent there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust, conceit, and views do not lie latent there. For an ordinary person, in the form realm and the formless realm, the latent tendencies of ignorance, conceit, and views lie latent there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and aversion do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the desire realm, in regard to two feelings, the latent tendencies of ignorance, sensual lust, conceit, and views lie latent there, but the latent tendency of aversion does not lie latent there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies of ignorance, aversion, and views lie latent there, but the latent tendencies of sensual lust and conceit do not lie latent there. (The Tetrad Root)

34. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

34. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt lie latent, for that person, there, does the latent tendency of craving for existence also lie latent? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusentīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency of ignorance lies latent, for that person, there, do the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt also lie latent?

Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo [V 2.0105] ca anusenti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya [T 1.0465] tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti. Puthujjanassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo anuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti. (Pañcakamūlakaṃ)

For a non-returner, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency of ignorance lies latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the desire realm, in regard to two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For two kinds of persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For those same persons, in the desire realm in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, sensual desire, and conceit lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of aversion, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies of ignorance and aversion lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, conceit, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For an ordinary person, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, conceit, views, and doubt lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire and aversion do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the desire realm in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, sensual desire, conceit, views, and doubt lie latent there, but the underlying tendency of aversion does not lie latent there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, aversion, views, and doubt lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire and conceit do not lie latent there. (The Five-Term Root)

35. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo anusetīti? Natthi.

35. For whomever, wherein the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence lie latent, does the underlying tendency of ignorance lie latent there? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo anuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo [M 2.0078] ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusentīti?

Or again, for whomever, wherein the underlying tendency of ignorance lies latent, do the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence lie latent there?

Anāgāmissa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha avijjānusayo anuseti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti[V 2.0106]. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca [T 1.0466] vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti. Puthujjanassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo [T 1.0467] ca anusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusanti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha avijjānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca anusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo [M 2.0079] ca mānānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca anusenti. (Chakkamūlakaṃ)

For a non-returner, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency of ignorance lies latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the desire realm in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendencies of ignorance and conceit lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, conceit, and craving for existence lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For two kinds of persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, conceit, and craving for existence lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, aversion, views, and doubt do not lie latent there. For those same persons, in the desire realm in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, sensual desire, and conceit lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of aversion, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not lie latent there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies of ignorance and aversion lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not lie latent there. For an ordinary person, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire and aversion do not lie latent there. For that same person, in the desire realm in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, sensual desire, conceit, views, and doubt lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of aversion and craving for existence do not lie latent there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies of ignorance, aversion, views, and doubt lie latent there, but the underlying tendencies of sensual desire, conceit, and craving for existence do not lie latent there. (The Six-Term Root)

Anusayavāre anulomaṃ.

In the Chapter on Underlying Tendencies, the Positive Section.

1. Anusayavāra

1. Chapter on Underlying Tendencies

(Gha) paṭilomapuggalo

(Gha) The Negative: Person

36. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0107] kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa paṭighānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

36. For one for whom the underlying tendency of sensual desire does not lie latent, does the underlying tendency of aversion not lie latent for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to sensual lust not underlie for him? Yes.

(Ka) yassa kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa mānānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to conceit not underlie for him?

Anāgāmissa kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa mānānusayo nānuseti. Arahato kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a non-returner, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to conceit does underlie for him. For an arahant, both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to conceit do not underlie.

(Kha) yassa vā pana mānānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to sensual lust not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not underlie, do the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to sensual lust not underlie for him?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti[T 1.0468]. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For two persons, the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to sensual lust does underlie for them. For two persons, both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to sensual lust do not underlie.

Yassa kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not underlie, do the underlying tendency to craving for existence… and the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie for him?

Anāgāmissa kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa avijjānusayo nānuseti. Arahato kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a non-returner, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does underlie for him. For an arahant, both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to ignorance do not underlie.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to sensual lust not underlie for him? Yes.

37. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0108] paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa mānānusayo nānusetīti?

37. For one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to conceit not underlie for him?

Anāgāmissa paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa mānānusayo [M 2.0080] nānuseti. Arahato paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a non-returner, the underlying tendency to aversion does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to conceit does underlie for him. For an arahant, both the underlying tendency to aversion and the underlying tendency to conceit do not underlie.

(Kha) yassa vā pana mānānusayo nānuseti tassa paṭighānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to aversion not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion does not underlie, do the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa paṭighānusayo nānusetīti?

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to aversion not underlie for him?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti.

For two persons, the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to aversion does underlie for them. For two persons, both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie.

Yassa paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion does not underlie, do the underlying tendency to craving for existence… and the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie for him?

Anāgāmissa paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa avijjānusayo nānuseti. Arahato paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a non-returner, the underlying tendency to aversion does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does underlie for him. For an arahant, both the underlying tendency to aversion and the underlying tendency to ignorance do not underlie.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa [T 1.0469] paṭighānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to aversion not underlie for him? Yes.

38. Yassa mānānusayo nānuseti tassa diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

38. For one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not underlie, do the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa mānānusayo nānusetīti?

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to conceit not underlie for him?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ mānānusayo [V 2.0109] nānuseti. Arahato vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, but the underlying tendency to conceit does underlie for them. For an arahant, both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to conceit do not underlie.

Yassa mānānusayo nānuseti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not underlie, do the underlying tendency to craving for existence… and the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa mānānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to conceit not underlie for him? Yes.

39. (Ka) yassa diṭṭhānusayo nānuseti tassa vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

39. For one for whom the underlying tendency to views does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to doubt not underlie for him? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa diṭṭhānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to views not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt do not underlie, do the underlying tendency to craving for existence… and the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie for him?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ avijjānusayo nānuseti. Arahato [M 2.0081] vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, but for them the underlying tendency to ignorance does underlie. For an arahant, both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to ignorance do not underlie.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to doubt not underlie for him? Yes.

40. (Ka) yassa bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

40. (Ka) For one for whom the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie for him? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā. (Ekamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not underlie, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence not underlie for him? Yes. (The Single Root)

41. (Ka) yassa [T 1.0470] kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa mānānusayo nānusetīti?

41. (Ka) For one for whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie, does the underlying tendency to conceit not underlie for him?

Anāgāmissa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca [V 2.0110] tassa mānānusayo nānuseti. Arahato kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a non-returner, both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie, but for him the underlying tendency to conceit does underlie. For an arahant, the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit do not underlie.

(Kha) yassa vā pana mānānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not underlie, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie, do the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt not underlie for him? Yes.

Yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion not underlie for him?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti.

For two persons, the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, but for them both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do underlie. For two persons, the underlying tendency to doubt does not underlie, and both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie.

Yassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie, do the underlying tendency to craving for existence… and the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie for him?

Anāgāmissa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa avijjānusayo nānuseti. Arahato kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a non-returner, both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not underlie, but for him the underlying tendency to ignorance does underlie. For an arahant, the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and ignorance do not underlie.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Dukamūlakaṃ)

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent, for that one, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion not lie latent? Yes. (The Pair-root)

42. Yassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti [T 1.0471] tassa diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā[M 2.0082].

42. For one for whom the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit do not lie latent, for that one, does the underlying tendency to views... and so on... the underlying tendency to doubt not lie latent? Yes.

Yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent, for that one, do the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit not lie latent?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no [V 2.0111] ca tesaṃ kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Anāgāmissa vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa mānānusayo nānuseti. Arahato vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti.

For two individuals, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent, but for them the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit do lie latent. For a Non-returner, the underlying tendencies to doubt, sensual lust, and aversion do not lie latent, but for that one the underlying tendency to conceit does lie latent. For an Arahant, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent, and the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit also do not lie latent.

Yassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

For one for whom the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit do not lie latent, for that one, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence... and so on... the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent? Yes.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Tikamūlakaṃ)

Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent, for that one, do the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit not lie latent? Yes. (The Triad-root)

43. (Ka) yassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti tassa vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

43. (a) For one for whom the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views do not lie latent, for that one, does the underlying tendency to doubt not lie latent? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusentīti?

(b) Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent, for that one, do the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views not lie latent?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ vicikicchānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Anāgāmissa vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa mānānusayo nānuseti[T 1.0472]. Arahato vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti…pe…. (Catukkamūlakaṃ)

For two individuals, both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to views do not lie latent, but for them the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit do lie latent. For a Non-returner, the underlying tendencies to doubt, sensual lust, aversion, and views do not lie latent, but for that one the underlying tendency to conceit does lie latent. For an Arahant, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent, and the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views also do not lie latent... and so on. (The Tetrad-root)

44. Yassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti tassa bhavarāgānusayo…pe… avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

44. For one for whom the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt do not lie latent, for that one, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence... and so on... the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent? Yes.

Yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo [V 2.0112] ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Pañcakamūlakaṃ)

45. (a) For one for whom the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not lie latent, for that one, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Chakkamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent, for that one, do the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence not lie latent? Yes. (The Hexad-root)

(b) Or where the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant, do the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion not lie dormant there? Yes. (The section on pairs of roots)

52. Yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

52. Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit do not lie dormant, does the underlying tendency to views … the underlying tendency to doubt not lie dormant there? Yes.

Yattha vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā.

Or where the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant, do the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit not lie dormant there? Yes.

(Ka) yattha [M 2.0088] kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo [T 1.0479] ca nānusenti tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

(a) Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit do not lie dormant, does the underlying tendency to lust for existence not lie dormant there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti?

(b) Or where the underlying tendency to lust for existence does not lie dormant, do the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit not lie dormant there?

Dukkhāya vedanāya ettha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu ettha bhavarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Apariyāpanne ettha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti.

In painful feeling, herein the underlying tendency to lust for existence, the underlying tendency to sensual lust, and the underlying tendency to conceit do not lie dormant, but the underlying tendency to aversion does lie dormant there. In the sense-sphere realm, in two feelings, herein the underlying tendency to lust for existence and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant, but the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to conceit do lie dormant there. In the unincluded, herein the underlying tendency to lust for existence does not lie dormant, and the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit do not lie dormant.

(Ka) yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

(a) Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit do not lie dormant, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie dormant there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Tikamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or where the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant, do the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, and the underlying tendency to conceit not lie dormant there? Yes. (The section on triplets of roots)

53. (Ka) yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti tattha vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

53. (a) Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, and the underlying tendency to views do not lie dormant, does the underlying tendency to doubt not lie dormant there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo [V 2.0119] ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā …pe…. (Catukkamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or where the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant, do the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, and the underlying tendency to views not lie dormant there? Yes. …pe… (The section on quartets of roots)

54. (Ka) yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

54. (a) Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt do not lie dormant, does the underlying tendency to lust for existence not lie dormant there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana bhavarāgānusayo [T 1.0480] nānuseti tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusentīti?

(b) Or where the underlying tendency to lust for existence does not lie dormant, do the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt not lie dormant there?

Dukkhāya vedanāya ettha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tattha paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu ettha bhavarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti. Apariyāpanne ettha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti [M 2.0089] kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti.

In regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to lust for existence, the underlying tendency to sensual lust, and the underlying tendency to conceit do not lie latent here; but the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt do lie latent there. In the sense-sphere realm, in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendency to lust for existence and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie latent here; but the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt do lie latent there. In the supramundane, the underlying tendency to lust for existence does not lie latent here, and the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt do not lie latent.

(Ka) yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

(a) Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, and the underlying tendency to doubt do not lie latent, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana…pe…? Āmantā. (Pañcakamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or where, on the other hand…? Yes. (The section on quintets of roots)

55. (Ka) yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusenti tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

55. (a) Where the underlying tendency to sensual lust, the underlying tendency to aversion, the underlying tendency to conceit, the underlying tendency to views, the underlying tendency to doubt, and the underlying tendency to lust for existence do not lie latent, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent there? Yes.

(Kha) yattha vā pana avijjānusayo nānuseti tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Chakkamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or where, on the other hand, the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent, do the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and lust for existence not lie latent there? Yes. (The section on sextets of roots)

(Ca) paṭilomapuggalokāsā

(c) Converse: Person and Location

56. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0120] yattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha paṭighānusayo nānusetīti?

56. (a) For whom, where the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā apariyāpanne tesaṃ [T 1.0481] tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to aversion does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the form realm, the formless realm, and the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent for them there. For two persons, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent for them anywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

(b) Or, on the other hand, for whom, where the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the sense-sphere realm and in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to sensual lust does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the form realm, the formless realm, and the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to sensual lust lies latent for them there. For two persons, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to sensual lust lies latent for them anywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha mānānusayo nānusetīti?

(a) For whom, where the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ [M 2.0090] tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent for them there. For a non-returner, in the sense-sphere realm, in regard to two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent for him there. For an arahant, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent for him anywhere.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0121] vā pana yattha mānānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā[T 1.0482].

(b) Or, on the other hand, for whom, where the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent? Yes.

Yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti?

For whom, where the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to views… up to… the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent?

Puthujjanassa dukkhāya vedanāya rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a worldling, in regard to painful feeling, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to doubt does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent for him there. For two persons, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent for them anywhere.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

(b) Or, on the other hand, for whom, where the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For two persons, in the sense-sphere realm and in regard to two feelings, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to sensual lust does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling, in the form realm, in the formless realm, and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to doubt nor the underlying tendency to sensual lust lies latent for them there. For two persons, neither the underlying tendency to doubt nor the underlying tendency to sensual lust lies latent for them anywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

(a) For whom, where the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent, for him, there the underlying tendency to lust for existence does not lie latent?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to lust for existence does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to lust for existence lies latent for them there. For a non-returner, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to lust for existence does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the sensual realm, in the three feelings, and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to lust for existence lies latent for him there. For an arahant, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to lust for existence lies latent for him anywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to lust for existence does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to sensual lust not lie latent for him there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to lust for existence nor the underlying tendency to sensual lust lies latent for them there. For an arahant, neither the underlying tendency to lust for existence nor the underlying tendency to sensual lust lies latent for him anywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent for him there?

Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in regard to painful feeling, the form realm, and the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent for them there. For a non-returner, in the sensual realm, in the three feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendency to sensual lust does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent for him there. For an arahant, neither the underlying tendency to sensual lust nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent for him anywhere.

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to sensual lust not lie latent for him there? Yes.

57. (Ka) yassa yattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha mānānusayo nānusetīti?

Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti.

For two persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to aversion does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the sensual realm, in two feelings, in the form realm, in the formless realm, and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to doubt nor the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent for them there. For two persons, neither the underlying tendency to doubt nor the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent for them anywhere.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0124] yattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to lust for existence not lie latent for him there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Anāgāmissa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo [M 2.0093] nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu apariyāpanne tassa tattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha paṭighānusayo [T 1.0486] ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to craving for existence does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the sensual realm, in two feelings, and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to craving for existence lies latent for them there. For a non-returner, in the form realm and the formless realm, the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to craving for existence does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the sensual realm, in the three feelings, and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to craving for existence lies latent for him there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to craving for existence lies latent anywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha paṭighānusayo nānusetīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to aversion not lie latent there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to aversion does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the sensual realm, in two feelings, and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to craving for existence nor the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent for them there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to craving for existence nor the underlying tendency to aversion lies latent anywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo [V 2.0125] ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha paṭighānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the sensual realm, in two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent for them there. For a non-returner, in the sensual realm, in three feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendency to aversion does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent for him there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to aversion nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent anywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha paṭighānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to aversion not lie latent there? Yes.

58. Yassa yattha mānānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti?

58. For one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent somewhere, do the underlying tendency to views and the underlying tendency to doubt not lie latent there?

Puthujjanassa dukkhāya vedanāya [T 1.0487] tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti, no ca tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha mānānusayo ca nānuseti vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha mānānusayo ca nānuseti vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti.

For a worldling, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent for him there, but the underlying tendency to doubt does lie latent for him there. For that same person, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to conceit nor the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent for him there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to conceit nor the underlying tendency to doubt lies latent anywhere.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha mānānusayo nānusetīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to conceit not lie latent there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu [M 2.0094] rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the sensual realm, in two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to doubt nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent for them there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to doubt nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent anywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha mānānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.
