For one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence not lie latent there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha mānānusayo nānusetīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to conceit not lie latent there?

Catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo [V 2.0126] ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For four persons, in the sensual realm and in two feelings, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in regard to painful feeling and in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to craving for existence nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent for them there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to craving for existence nor the underlying tendency to conceit lies latent anywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha mānānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not lie latent there?

Catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo [T 1.0488] nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha mānānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For four persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie latent for them there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie latent for them there. For those same persons, in the unincluded, neither the underlying tendency to conceit nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent for them there. For an Arahant, neither the underlying tendency to conceit nor the underlying tendency to ignorance lies latent anywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha mānānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to conceit not lie latent there? Yes.

59. (Ka) yassa yattha diṭṭhānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

59. For one for whom the underlying tendency to views does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to doubt not lie latent there? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to views not lie latent there? Yes.

Yassa yattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to views and the underlying tendency to doubt do not lie latent somewhere, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence not lie latent there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha vicikicchānusayo [M 2.0095] ca nānuseti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to craving for existence does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the sense-sphere, in the three feelings, and in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for them there and the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant for them there. For the Arahant, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant anywhere and the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant anywhere.

Yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to doubt also not lie dormant there?

Puthujjanassa kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti[V 2.0127], no ca tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti vicikicchānusayo [T 1.0489] ca nānuseti.

For a worldling, in the sense-sphere and in the three feelings, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to doubt does lie dormant for them there. For that same person, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant for them there and the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for them there. For the Arahant, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant everywhere and the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant everywhere.

(Ka) yassa yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to ignorance also not lie dormant there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the sense-sphere, in the three feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for them there and the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant for them there. For the Arahant, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant anywhere and the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant anywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to doubt also not lie dormant there? Yes.

60. (Ka) yassa yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

60. For one for whom the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to ignorance also not lie dormant there?

Catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti, no ca tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For four persons, in the sense-sphere and in the three feelings, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant for them there and the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant for them there. For the Arahant, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not lie dormant everywhere and the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant everywhere.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā. (Ekamūlakaṃ)

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to ignorance does not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence also not lie dormant there? Yes.

61. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha mānānusayo nānusetīti?

61. For one for whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to conceit also not lie dormant there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo [V 2.0128] nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne [T 1.0490] tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca [M 2.0096] nānusenti mānānusayo ca nānuseti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti mānānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti mānānusayo ca nānuseti.

For three persons, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for them there, and the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie dormant for them there. For the non-returner, in the sense-sphere, in two feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for that person there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does lie dormant for that person there. For that same person, in painful feeling and in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for that person there, and the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie dormant for that person there. For the Arahant, everywhere, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant, and the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie dormant.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha mānānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie dormant wherever, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion also not lie dormant there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti. Arahato sabbattha mānānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti.

For three persons, in painful feeling, the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to sensual lust do not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to aversion does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie dormant for them there, and the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for them there. For the Arahant, everywhere, the underlying tendency to conceit does not lie dormant, and the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant.

Yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to views… does the underlying tendency to doubt also not lie dormant there?

Puthujjanassa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti vicikicchānusayo [T 1.0491] ca nānuseti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha…pe….

For the worldling, in the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for that person there, but the underlying tendency to doubt does lie dormant for that person there. For that same person, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for that person there, and the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for that person there. For two persons, everywhere… and so on.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or, for one for whom the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant wherever, do both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion also not lie dormant there?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti[V 2.0129]. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ sabbattha…pe….

For two persons, in painful feeling, the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to sensual lust do not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to aversion does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the sense-sphere and in two feelings, the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for them there, but the underlying tendency to sensual lust does lie dormant for them there. For those same persons, in the form-sphere, the formless-sphere, and the supramundane, the underlying tendency to doubt does not lie dormant for them there, and the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant for them there. For two persons, everywhere… and so on.

(Ka) yassa [M 2.0097] yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti?

For one for whom both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion do not lie dormant wherever, does the underlying tendency to craving for existence also not lie dormant there?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Anāgāmissa rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha…pe….

For three persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, for them there the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie, but the latent tendency to craving for existence does underlie there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, for them there the latent tendency to sensual desire, the latent tendency to aversion, and the latent tendency to craving for existence do not underlie. For the non-returner, in the form realm and the formless realm, for that person there the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie, but the latent tendency to craving for existence does underlie there. For that same person, in the desire realm, in regard to the three feelings, and in the supramundane, for that person there the latent tendency to sensual desire, the latent tendency to aversion, and the latent tendency to craving for existence do not underlie. For the arahant, everywhere… and so on.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha [T 1.0492] bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency to craving for existence does not underlie, for that person there do the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion not underlie?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti. Arahato sabbattha…pe….

For three persons, in regard to painful feeling, for them there the latent tendency to craving for existence and the latent tendency to sensual desire do not underlie, but the latent tendency to aversion does underlie there. For those same persons, in the desire realm and in regard to the two feelings, for them there the latent tendency to craving for existence and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie, but the latent tendency to sensual desire does underlie there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, for them there the latent tendency to craving for existence does not underlie, and the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie. For the arahant, everywhere… and so on.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

For whomever, wherever the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie, for that person there does the latent tendency to ignorance not underlie?

Tiṇṇaṃ [V 2.0130] puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha…pe….

For three persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, for them there the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie, but the latent tendency to ignorance does underlie there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, for them there the latent tendency to sensual desire, the latent tendency to aversion, and the latent tendency to ignorance do not underlie. For a non-returner, in the desire realm, in the three feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, for that person there the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie, but the latent tendency to ignorance does underlie there. For that same person, in the supramundane, for that person there the latent tendency to sensual desire, the latent tendency to aversion, and the latent tendency to ignorance do not underlie. For an arahant, everywhere… and so on.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha [M 2.0098] avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Dukamūlakaṃ)

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency to ignorance does not underlie, for that person there do the latent tendency to sensual desire and the latent tendency to aversion not underlie? Yes. (The Two-Rooted Section)

62. Yassa [T 1.0493] yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha diṭṭhānusayo…pe… vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

62. For whomever, wherever the latent tendency to sensual desire, the latent tendency to aversion, and the latent tendency to conceit do not underlie, for that person there do the latent tendency to views and the latent tendency to doubt not underlie? Yes.

Yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency to doubt does not underlie, for that person there do the latent tendency to sensual desire, the latent tendency to aversion, and the latent tendency to conceit not underlie?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo [V 2.0131] ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Arahato sabbattha…pe….

For two persons, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendency to doubt, the latent tendency to sensual desire, and the latent tendency to conceit do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendency to aversion does underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the desire realm and in regard to the two feelings, the latent tendency to doubt and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendencies to sensual desire and conceit do underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the form realm and the formless realm, the latent tendency to doubt, the latent tendency to sensual desire, and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendency to conceit does underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the latent tendency to doubt does not underlie for them there, and the latent tendencies to sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie for them there. For a non-returner, in the desire realm, in regard to the two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, the latent tendency to doubt, the latent tendency to sensual desire, and the latent tendency to aversion do not underlie for him there, but the latent tendency to conceit does underlie for him there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling and in the supramundane, the latent tendency to doubt does not underlie for him there, and the latent tendencies to sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie for him there. For an arahant, everywhere… and so on.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo [T 1.0494] ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies to sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie, for that person there does the latent tendency to craving for existence not underlie? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti?

Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency to craving for existence does not underlie, for that person there do the latent tendencies to sensual desire, aversion, and conceit not underlie?

Tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti[M 2.0099], no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Arahato sabbattha…pe….

For three persons, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies for craving for existence, sensual desire, and conceit do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendency for aversion does underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the desire realm, in regard to the two feelings, the latent tendencies for craving for existence and aversion do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendencies for sensual desire and conceit do underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the latent tendency for craving for existence does not underlie for them there, and the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie for them there. For a non-returner, in the desire realm, in regard to the two feelings, the latent tendencies for craving for existence, sensual desire, and aversion do not underlie for him there, but the latent tendency for conceit does underlie for him there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling and in the supramundane, the latent tendency for craving for existence does not underlie for him there, and the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie for him there. For an arahant, everywhere… and so on.

(Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

(Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie, for them there does the latent tendency for ignorance not underlie?

Anāgāmissa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa [T 1.0495] tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha…pe….

For a non-returner, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie for him there, but the latent tendency for ignorance does underlie for him there. For that same person, in the supramundane, the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, and conceit do not underlie for him there, and the latent tendency for ignorance also does not underlie. For an arahant, everywhere… and so on.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0132] vā pana yattha avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Tikamūlakaṃ)

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency for ignorance does not underlie, for them there do the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, and conceit not underlie? Yes. (The Triplet Section)

63. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

63. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, and views do not underlie, for them there does the latent tendency for doubt not underlie? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha vicikicchānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusentīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency for doubt does not underlie, for them there do the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, and views not underlie?

Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne [M 2.0100] tesaṃ tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā [T 1.0496] tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tassa tattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti. Arahato sabbattha vicikicchānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca nānusenti …pe…. (Catukkamūlakaṃ)

For two persons, in regard to painful feeling, the latent tendencies for doubt, sensual desire, conceit, and views do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendency for aversion does underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the desire realm and in regard to the two feelings, the latent tendencies for doubt and aversion do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendencies for sensual desire and conceit do underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the form sphere and the formless sphere, the latent tendencies for doubt, sensual desire, aversion, and views do not underlie for them there, but the latent tendency for conceit does underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the latent tendency for doubt does not underlie for them there, and the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, and views do not underlie for them there. For a non-returner, in the desire realm, in regard to the two feelings, in the form sphere, and in the formless sphere, the latent tendencies for doubt, sensual desire, aversion, and views do not underlie for him there, but the latent tendency for conceit does underlie for him there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling and in the supramundane, the latent tendency for doubt does not underlie for him there, and the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, and views do not underlie for him there. For an arahant, everywhere the latent tendency for doubt does not underlie, and the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, and views do not underlie… and so on. (The Tetrad Section)

64. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0133] yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo nānusetīti? Āmantā.

64. (Ka) For whomever, wherever the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt do not underlie, for them there does the latent tendency for craving for existence not underlie? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha bhavarāgānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusentīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomever, wherever the latent tendency for craving for existence does not underlie, for them there do the latent tendencies for sensual desire, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt not underlie?

Puthujjanassa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti. Tasseva puggalassa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo [T 1.0497] ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti. Dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ dukkhāya vedanāya tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha paṭighānusayo nānuseti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tesaṃ tattha [M 2.0101] kāmarāgānusayo ca mānānusayo ca nānusenti. Tesaññeva puggalānaṃ apariyāpanne tesaṃ tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti. Anāgāmissa kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha mānānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa dukkhāya vedanāya apariyāpanne tassa tattha bhavarāgānusayo ca nānuseti kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo [V 2.0134] ca nānusenti. Arahato sabbattha…pe…. (Pañcakamūlakaṃ)

For a worldling, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies to craving for existence, sensual lust, and conceit do not underlie for him there, but the underlying tendencies to aversion, views, and doubt do underlie for him there. For that same person, in the sense-sphere and in regard to the two feelings, the underlying tendencies to craving for existence and aversion do not underlie for him there, but the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, conceit, views, and doubt do underlie for him there. For that same person, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not underlie for him there, and the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt do not underlie for him there. For two persons, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies to craving for existence, sensual lust, conceit, views, and doubt do not underlie for them there, but the underlying tendency to aversion does underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the sense-sphere and in regard to the two feelings, the underlying tendencies to craving for existence, aversion, views, and doubt do not underlie for them there, but the underlying tendencies to sensual lust and conceit do underlie for them there. For those same persons, in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not underlie for them there, and the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt do not underlie for them there. For a non-returner, in the sense-sphere and in regard to the two feelings, the underlying tendencies to craving for existence, sensual lust, aversion, views, and doubt do not underlie for him there, but the underlying tendency to conceit does underlie for him there. For that same person, in regard to painful feeling and in the supramundane, the underlying tendency to craving for existence does not underlie for him there, and the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt do not underlie for him there. For an arahant, everywhere… and so on. (The Pentad Section)

65. (Ka) yassa yattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusenti tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānusetīti?

65. (a) For one for whom, where the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not underlie, for that person, there, does the underlying tendency to ignorance not underlie?

Anāgāmissa dukkhāya vedanāya tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo [T 1.0498] ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusenti, no ca tassa tattha avijjānusayo nānuseti. Tasseva puggalassa apariyāpanne tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusenti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti. Arahato sabbattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusenti avijjānusayo ca nānuseti.

For the non-returner, in regard to painful feeling, the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not underlie for him there, but the underlying tendency to ignorance does underlie for him there. For that same person, in the supramundane, the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not underlie for him there, and the underlying tendency to ignorance also does not underlie. For the arahant, everywhere, the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence do not underlie, and the underlying tendency to ignorance also does not underlie.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yattha avijjānusayo nānuseti tassa tattha kāmarāgānusayo ca paṭighānusayo ca mānānusayo ca diṭṭhānusayo ca vicikicchānusayo ca bhavarāgānusayo ca nānusentīti? Āmantā. (Chakkamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or again, for one for whom, where the underlying tendency to ignorance does not underlie, for that person, there, do the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, doubt, and craving for existence not underlie? Yes. (The Hexad Section)

Anusayavāre paṭilomaṃ.

The Negative Series in the Section on Underlying Tendencies.

Anusayavāro.

The Section on Underlying Tendencies.

2. Sānusayavāro

2. The Section on [Persons] with Underlying Tendencies

(Ka) anulomapuggalo

(a) Positive Interrogation

66. (Ka) yo [M 2.0102][V 2.0135] kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo so paṭighānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

66. (a) Is a person who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust also one who has the underlying tendency to aversion? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana paṭighānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, is a person who has the underlying tendency to aversion also one who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust? Yes.

(Ka) yo kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo so mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(a) Is a person who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust also one who has the underlying tendency to conceit? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana mānānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or again, is a person who has the underlying tendency to conceit also one who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust?

Anāgāmī mānānusayena sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo. Tayo puggalā [T 1.0499] mānānusayena ca sānusayā kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayā.

A non-returner has the underlying tendency to conceit, but does not have the underlying tendency to sensual lust. Three persons have both the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to sensual lust.

Yo kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo so diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti?

Is a person who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust also one who has the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt?

Dve puggalā kāmarāgānusayena sānusayā, no ca vicikicchānusayena sānusayā. Puthujjano kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayo vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo.

Two persons have the underlying tendency to sensual lust, but do not have the underlying tendency to doubt. A worldling has both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to doubt.

Yo vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Or again, is a person who has the underlying tendency to doubt also one who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust? Yes.

Yo kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Is a person who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust also one who has the underlying tendency to craving for existence… and the underlying tendency to ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

Or again, is a person who has the underlying tendency to ignorance also one who has the underlying tendency to sensual lust?

Anāgāmī avijjānusayena [V 2.0136] sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo. Tayo puggalā avijjānusayena ca sānusayā kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayā.

A non-returner has the underlying tendency to ignorance, but does not have the underlying tendency to sensual lust. Three persons have both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to sensual lust.

67. (Ka) yo paṭighānusayena sānusayo so mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

67. (a) Is a person who has the underlying tendency to aversion also one who has the underlying tendency to conceit? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana mānānusayena sānusayo so paṭighānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or again, is a person who has the underlying tendency to conceit also one who has the underlying tendency to aversion?

Anāgāmī mānānusayena sānusayo, no ca paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Tayo puggalā mānānusayena ca sānusayā paṭighānusayena ca sānusayā.

A non-returner has the underlying tendency to conceit, but does not have the underlying tendency to aversion. Three persons have both the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to aversion.

Yo paṭighānusayena sānusayo so diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti?

Is a person who has the underlying tendency to aversion also one who has the underlying tendency to views… and the underlying tendency to doubt?

Dve puggalā paṭighānusayena sānusayā[M 2.0103], no ca vicikicchānusayena sānusayā. Puthujjano paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo.

Two persons have the underlying tendency of aversion, but do not have the underlying tendency of doubt. A worldling has both the underlying tendency of aversion and the underlying tendency of doubt.

Yo vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so paṭighānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendency of aversion? Yes.

Yo paṭighānusayena [T 1.0500] sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Is a person who has the underlying tendency of aversion also one who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence… and the underlying tendency of ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so paṭighānusayena sānusayoti?

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of ignorance also one who has the underlying tendency of aversion?

Anāgāmī avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Tayo puggalā avijjānusayena ca sānusayā paṭighānusayena ca sānusayā.

A non-returner has the underlying tendency of ignorance, but does not have the underlying tendency of aversion. Three persons have both the underlying tendency of ignorance and the underlying tendency of aversion.

68. Yo mānānusayena sānusayo so diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti?

68. Is a person who has the underlying tendency of conceit also one who has the underlying tendency of views… and the underlying tendency of doubt?

Tayo [V 2.0137] puggalā mānānusayena sānusayā, no ca vicikicchānusayena sānusayā. Puthujjano mānānusayena ca sānusayo vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo.

Three persons have the underlying tendency of conceit, but do not have the underlying tendency of doubt. A worldling has both the underlying tendency of conceit and the underlying tendency of doubt.

Yo vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendency of conceit? Yes.

Yo mānānusayena sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Is a person who has the underlying tendency of conceit also one who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence… and the underlying tendency of ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of ignorance also one who has the underlying tendency of conceit? Yes.

69. (Ka) yo diṭṭhānusayena sānusayo so vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

69. (a) Is a person who has the underlying tendency of views also one who has the underlying tendency of doubt? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so diṭṭhānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā …pe….

(b) Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendency of views? Yes…

70. Yo vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

70. Is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence… and the underlying tendency of ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti?

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of ignorance also one who has the underlying tendency of doubt?

Tayo puggalā avijjānusayena sānusayā, no ca vicikicchānusayena sānusayā. Puthujjano [T 1.0501] avijjānusayena ca sānusayo vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo.

Three persons have the underlying tendency of ignorance, but do not have the underlying tendency of doubt. A worldling has both the underlying tendency of ignorance and the underlying tendency of doubt.

71. (Ka) yo [M 2.0104] bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo so avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

71. (a) Is a person who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence also one who has the underlying tendency of ignorance? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā. (Ekamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of ignorance also one who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence? Yes. (The Single-rooted Section)

72. (Ka) yo [V 2.0138] kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo so mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

72. (a) Is a person who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion also one who has the underlying tendency of conceit? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana mānānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti?

(b) Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of conceit also one who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion?

Anāgāmī mānānusayena sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Tayo puggalā mānānusayena ca sānusayā kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayā.

A non-returner has the underlying tendency of conceit, but does not have the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion. Three persons have the underlying tendencies of conceit, sensual lust, and aversion.

Yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo so diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti?

Is a person who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion also one who has the underlying tendency of views… and the underlying tendency of doubt?

Dve puggalā kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayā, no ca vicikicchānusayena sānusayā. Puthujjano kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo.

Two persons have the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion, but do not have the underlying tendency of doubt. A worldling has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and doubt.

Yo vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion? Yes.

Yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Is a person who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion also one who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence… and the underlying tendency of ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of ignorance also one who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion?

Anāgāmī avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena [T 1.0502] ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Tayo puggalā avijjānusayena ca sānusayā kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayā. (Dukamūlakaṃ)

A non-returner has the underlying tendency of ignorance, but does not have the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion. Three persons have the underlying tendencies of ignorance, sensual lust, and aversion. (The Two-rooted Section)

73. Yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo so diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti?

73. Is a person who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit also one who has the underlying tendency of views… and the underlying tendency of doubt?

Dve puggalā kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayā, no ca vicikicchānusayena sānusayā. Puthujjano kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo.

Two persons have the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit, but do not have the underlying tendency of doubt. A worldling has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and doubt.

Yo [V 2.0139] vā pana vicikicchānusayena [M 2.0105] sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit? Yes.

Yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Is a person who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit also one who has the underlying tendency of craving for existence… and the underlying tendency of ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of ignorance also one who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, and conceit?

Anāgāmī avijjānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Tayo puggalā avijjānusayena ca sānusayā kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayā. (Tikamūlakaṃ)

A non-returner has the underlying tendencies of ignorance and conceit, but does not have the underlying tendencies of sensual lust and aversion. Three persons have the underlying tendencies of ignorance, sensual lust, aversion, and conceit. (The Three-rooted Section)

74. (Ka) yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo so vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

74. (a) Is a person who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views also one who has the underlying tendency of doubt? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayoti[T 1.0503]? Āmantā …pe…. (Catukkamūlakaṃ)

(b) Or, is a person who has the underlying tendency of doubt also one who has the underlying tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views? Yes… (The Four-rooted Section)

75. Yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo so bhavarāgānusayena…pe… avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

75. Is a person who has the latent tendency of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of conceit, and of views, and of doubt, also a person who has the latent tendency of craving for existence… and of ignorance? Yes.

Yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or again, is a person who has the latent tendency of ignorance also a person who has the latent tendencies of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of conceit, and of views, and of doubt?

Anāgāmī avijjānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo. Dve puggalā avijjānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayā, no ca [V 2.0140] diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayā. Puthujjano avijjānusayena ca sānusayo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo. (Pañcakamūlakaṃ)

A non-returner has the latent tendencies of ignorance and conceit, but not the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, views, and doubt. Two persons have the latent tendencies of ignorance, sensual lust, aversion, and conceit, but not the latent tendencies of views and doubt. A worldling has the latent tendency of ignorance, and also the latent tendencies of sensual lust, aversion, conceit, views, and doubt. (The Five-rooted Section)

76. (Ka) yo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayo so [M 2.0106] avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

76. (a) Is a person who has the latent tendencies of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of conceit, and of views, and of doubt, and of craving for existence, also a person who has the latent tendency of ignorance? Yes.

(Kha) yo vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo so kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayoti?

(b) Or again, is a person who has the latent tendency of ignorance also a person who has the latent tendencies of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of conceit, and of views, and of doubt, and of craving for existence?

Anāgāmī avijjānusayena ca mānānusayena ca bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena [T 1.0504] ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo. Dve puggalā avijjānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayā, no ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayā. Puthujjano avijjānusayena ca sānusayo kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca vicikicchānusayena ca bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayo. (Chakkamūlakaṃ)

A non-returner has the latent tendencies of ignorance, and of conceit, and of craving for existence, but not the latent tendencies of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of views, and of doubt. Two persons have the latent tendencies of ignorance, and of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of conceit, and of craving for existence, but not the latent tendencies of views and doubt. A worldling has the latent tendency of ignorance, and also the latent tendencies of sensual lust, and of aversion, and of conceit, and of views, and of doubt, and of craving for existence. (The Six-rooted Section)

(Kha) anulomaokāso

(Kha) The Positive Plane

77. (Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo tato paṭighānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(a) Where one has the latent tendency of sensual lust, does one there also have the latent tendency of aversion? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana paṭighānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(Kha) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to aversion, is one there also subject to the underlying tendency to sensual lust? No.

(Ka) yato [V 2.0141] kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo tato mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

77. (a) Where one has the latent tendency of sensual lust, does one there also have the latent tendency of conceit? Yes.

(Kha) yato vā pana mānānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or again, where one has the latent tendency of conceit, does one there also have the latent tendency of sensual lust?

Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato mānānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato mānānusayena ca sānusayo kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the form realm and the formless realm, one there has the latent tendency of conceit, but not the latent tendency of sensual lust. In the sense-sphere realm, in regard to two feelings, one there has both the latent tendency of conceit and the latent tendency of sensual lust.

Yato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo tato diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

Where one has the latent tendency of sensual lust, does one there also have the latent tendency of views... and of doubt? Yes.

Yato vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

Or again, where one has the latent tendency of doubt, does one there also have the latent tendency of sensual lust?

Dukkhāya vedanāya rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayo.

In regard to painful feeling, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, one there has the latent tendency of doubt, but not the latent tendency of sensual lust. In the sense-sphere realm, in regard to two feelings, one there has both the latent tendency of doubt and the latent tendency of sensual lust.

(Ka) yato [M 2.0107] kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena [T 1.0505] sānusayoti? No.

(a) Where one has the latent tendency of sensual lust, does one there also have the latent tendency of craving for existence? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(b) Or again, where one has the latent tendency of craving for existence, does one there also have the latent tendency of sensual lust? No.

(Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(a) Where one has the latent tendency of sensual lust, does one there also have the latent tendency of ignorance? Yes.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or again, where one has the latent tendency of ignorance, does one there also have the latent tendency of sensual lust?

Dukkhāya vedanāya rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu [V 2.0142] tato avijjānusayena ca sānusayo kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayo.

In regard to painful feeling, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, one there has the latent tendency of ignorance, but not the latent tendency of sensual lust. In the sense-sphere realm, in regard to two feelings, one there has both the latent tendency of ignorance and the latent tendency of sensual lust.

78. (Ka) yato paṭighānusayena sānusayo tato mānānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(a) Where one has the latent tendency of aversion, does one there also have the latent tendency of conceit? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana mānānusayena sānusayo tato paṭighānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(b) Or again, where one has the latent tendency of conceit, does one there also have the latent tendency of aversion? No.

Yato paṭighānusayena sānusayo tato diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

78. Where one has the latent tendency of aversion, does one there also have the latent tendency of views... and of doubt? Yes.

Yato vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato paṭighānusayena sānusayoti?

Or again, where one has the latent tendency of doubt, does one there also have the latent tendency of aversion?

Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the sense-sphere realm in regard to two feelings, in the form realm, and in the formless realm, one there has the latent tendency of doubt, but not the latent tendency of aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one there has both the latent tendency of doubt and the latent tendency of aversion.

(Ka) yato paṭighānusayena sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(a) Where one has the latent tendency of aversion, does one there also have the latent tendency of craving for existence? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato paṭighānusayena sānusayoti? No.

(b) Or again, where one has the latent tendency of craving for existence, does one there also have the latent tendency of aversion? No.

(Ka) yato paṭighānusayena sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(a) Where one has the latent tendency of aversion, does one there also have the latent tendency of ignorance? Yes.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena [T 1.0506] sānusayo tato paṭighānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or again, where one has the latent tendency of ignorance, does one there also have the latent tendency of aversion?

Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato avijjānusayena ca sānusayo paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the sense-sphere, in two feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to aversion.

79. Yato [M 2.0108][V 2.0143] mānānusayena sānusayo tato diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

79. Where one is subject to the underlying tendency to conceit, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to views …pe… and to doubt? Yes.

Yato vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato mānānusayena sānusayoti?

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit?

Dukkhāya vedanāya tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato mānānusayena sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo mānānusayena ca sānusayo.

In regard to painful feeling, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit. In the sense-sphere, in two feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to conceit.

(Ka) yato mānānusayena sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

(a) Where one is subject to the underlying tendency to conceit, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence?

Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato mānānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo. Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato mānānusayena ca sānusayo bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the sense-sphere, in two feelings, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence. In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to craving for existence.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato mānānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit? Yes.

(Ka) yato mānānusayena sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(a) Where one is subject to the underlying tendency to conceit, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance? Yes.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo tato mānānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit?

Dukkhāya vedanāya tato avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato mānānusayena sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena ca sānusayo mānānusayena [T 1.0507] ca sānusayo.

In regard to painful feeling, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit. In the sense-sphere, in two feelings, in the form-sphere, and in the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to conceit.

80. (Ka) yato diṭṭhānusayena sānusayo tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

80. (a) Where one is subject to the underlying tendency to views, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to doubt? Yes.

(Kha) yato vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato diṭṭhānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā …pe….

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to views? Yes …pe….

81. (Ka) yato [V 2.0144] vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

81. (a) Where one is subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence?

Kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo. Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena ca sānusayo bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the sense-sphere, in regard to the three feelings, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence. In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to craving for existence.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to doubt? Yes.

82. (Ka) yato [M 2.0109] bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Āmantā.

82. (a) Where one is subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance? Yes.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti?

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence?

Kāmadhātuyā tīsu vedanāsu tato avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo. Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena ca sānusayo bhavarāgānusayena ca sānusayo. (Ekamūlakaṃ)

In the sense-sphere, in regard to the three feelings, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence. In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to craving for existence. (The Single Root Section)

83. (Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo tato mānānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

83. (a) Where one is subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit? There is not.

(Kha) yato vā pana mānānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti?

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to conceit, is one thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion?

Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato mānānusayena sānusayo, no [T 1.0508] ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato mānānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo.

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to conceit, but not thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion. In the sense-sphere, in regard to two feelings, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to conceit and the underlying tendency to sensual lust, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to aversion.

Yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo tato diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

Where one is subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to views …pe… to the underlying tendency to doubt? There is not.

Yato [V 2.0145] vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti?

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, is one thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion?

Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato vicikicchānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato vicikicchānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo.

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, but not thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion. In the sense-sphere, in regard to two feelings, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to sensual lust, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to aversion, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to sensual lust.

(Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

(a) Where one is subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence? There is not.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti? No.

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to craving for existence, is one thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion? No.

(Ka) yato [M 2.0110] kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

(a) Where one is subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance? There is not.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayoti?

(b) Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, is one thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion?

Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato avijjānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena [T 1.0509] ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato avijjānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena sānusayo. (Dukamūlakaṃ)

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is thereby subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, but not thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion. In the sense-sphere, in regard to two feelings, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to sensual lust, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one is thereby subject to both the underlying tendency to ignorance and the underlying tendency to aversion, but not thereby subject to the underlying tendency to sensual lust. (The Pair-Root Section)

84. Yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo tato diṭṭhānusayena…pe… vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

84. Where one is subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit, is one thereby subject to the underlying tendency to views …pe… to the underlying tendency to doubt? There is not.

Yato vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, is one there also subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit?

Rūpadhātuyā [V 2.0146] arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato vicikicchānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato vicikicchānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is there subject to the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to conceit, but not to the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to aversion. In the sense-sphere, in regard to two feelings, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to doubt, sensual lust, and conceit, but not to the underlying tendency to aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one is there subject to the underlying tendency to doubt and the underlying tendency to aversion, but not to the underlying tendency to sensual lust and the underlying tendency to conceit.

(Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

Where one is subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit, is one there also subject to the underlying tendency to lust for existence? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayoti? Mānānusayena sānusayo.

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to lust for existence, is one there also subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit? One is subject to the underlying tendency to conceit.

(Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena [T 1.0510] ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

Where one is subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit, is one there also subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena [M 2.0111] ca mānānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, is one there also subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, and conceit?

Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato avijjānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato avijjānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo. (Tikamūlakaṃ)

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to ignorance and conceit, but not to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust and aversion. In the sense-sphere, in regard to two feelings, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to ignorance, sensual lust, and conceit, but not to the underlying tendency to aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to ignorance and aversion, but not to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust and conceit. (The Triple-Root Section)

85. (Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo tato vicikicchānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

85. Where one is subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views, is one there also subject to the underlying tendency to doubt? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana vicikicchānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to doubt, is one there also subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views?

Rūpadhātuyā [V 2.0147] arūpadhātuyā tato vicikicchānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato vicikicchānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato vicikicchānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo.

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to doubt, conceit, and views, but not to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust and aversion. In the sense-sphere, in regard to two feelings, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to doubt, sensual lust, conceit, and views, but not to the underlying tendency to aversion. In regard to painful feeling, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to doubt, aversion, and views, but not to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust and conceit.

(Ka) yato [T 1.0511] kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo tato bhavarāgānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

Where one is subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views, is one there also subject to the underlying tendency to lust for existence? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana bhavarāgānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayoti?

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to lust for existence, is one there also subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views?

Mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo.

One is subject to the underlying tendencies to conceit and views.

(Ka) yato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo tato avijjānusayena sānusayoti? Natthi.

Where one is subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views, is one there also subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance? No.

(Kha) yato vā pana avijjānusayena sānusayo tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayoti[M 2.0112]?

Or conversely, where one is subject to the underlying tendency to ignorance, is one there also subject to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust, aversion, conceit, and views?

Rūpadhātuyā arūpadhātuyā tato avijjānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca sānusayo. Kāmadhātuyā dvīsu vedanāsu tato avijjānusayena ca kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato paṭighānusayena sānusayo. Dukkhāya vedanāya tato avijjānusayena ca paṭighānusayena ca diṭṭhānusayena ca sānusayo, no ca tato kāmarāgānusayena ca mānānusayena ca sānusayo. (Catukkamūlakaṃ)

In the form-sphere and the formless-sphere, one is there subject to the underlying tendencies to ignorance, conceit, and views, but not to the underlying tendencies to sensual lust and aversion.
