For whomever a mind has not arisen, for them, did that mind not arise?

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ?

Or again, for whomever a mind did not arise, for them, has that mind not arisen?

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati?

For whomever a mind has arisen, for them, will that mind arise?

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ?

Or again, for whomever a mind will arise, for them, has that mind arisen?

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati?

For whomever a mind has not arisen, for them, will that mind not arise?

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ?

Or again, for whomever a mind will not arise, for them, has that mind not arisen?

(11) Atītānāgatavāro

(11) The Section on the Past and Future

57. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati?

57. For whomever a mind arose and for them that mind has not arisen, for them will that mind arise?

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha?

Or again, for whomever a mind will arise and for them that mind has not arisen, for them did that mind arise?

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na [T 2.0013] uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati?

For whomever a mind did not arise, and for them that mind has arisen, for them will that mind not arise?

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0386] vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha?

Or again, for whomever a mind will not arise, and for them that mind has arisen, for them did that mind not arise?

(12) Uppannuppajjamānavāro

(12) The Section on the Arisen and the Arising

58. (Ka) uppannaṃ uppajjamānaṃ?

58. Is the arisen arising?

(Kha) uppajjamānaṃ uppannaṃ?

Is the arising arisen?

(Ka) na uppannaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ?

Is the not-arisen not arising?

(Kha) na uppajjamānaṃ na uppannaṃ?

Is the not-arising not arisen?

(13) Niruddhanirujjhamānavāro

(13) The Section on the Ceased and the Ceasing

59. (Ka) niruddhaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ?

59. Is the ceased ceasing?

(Kha) nirujjhamānaṃ niruddhaṃ?

Is the ceasing ceased?

(Ka) na niruddhaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ?

Is the not-ceased not ceasing?

(Kha) na nirujjhamānaṃ na niruddhaṃ?

Is the not-ceasing not ceased?

(14) Atikkantakālavāro

(14) The Section on Past Time

60. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ?

60. For whomever a certain mind's arising moment has passed and is of past time, for them, is that same mind's ceasing moment passed and of past time?

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ [M 2.0300] khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ?

Or again, for whomever a certain mind's ceasing moment has passed and is of past time, for them, is that same mind's arising moment passed and of past time?

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ?

For whomever a certain mind's arising moment has not passed and is not of past time, for them, is that same mind's ceasing moment not passed and not of past time?

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ[V 2.0387], na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ?

Or again, for whomever a certain mind's ceasing moment has not passed and is not of past time, for them, is that same mind's arising moment not passed and not of past time?

2. Suttantacittamissakaviseso

2. Special Section on Mind Mixed with the Suttanta Method

61. Yassa sarāgaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati…pe… yassa vītarāgaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa sadosaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa vītadosaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa samohaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa vītamohaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati [T 2.0014]… yassa saṃkhittaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa vikkhittaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa mahaggataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa amahaggataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa sauttaraṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa anuttaraṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa samāhitaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa asamāhitaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa vimuttaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa avimuttaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati…?

61. For whom a mind with lust is arising… (etc.) … For whom a mind without lust is arising… For whom a mind with hatred is arising… For whom a mind without hatred is arising… For whom a mind with delusion is arising… For whom a mind without delusion is arising … For whom a constricted mind is arising… For whom a scattered mind is arising… For whom a sublime mind is arising… For whom a non-sublime mind is arising… For whom a surpassable mind is arising… For whom an unsurpassed mind is arising… For whom a concentrated mind is arising… For whom an unconcentrated mind is arising… For whom a liberated mind is arising… For whom an unliberated mind is arising…?

3. Abhidhammacittamissakaviseso

3. Special Section on Mind Mixed with the Abhidhamma Method

62. Yassa kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati…pe… yassa akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa abyākataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati… yassa sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati…?

62. For whom a wholesome mind is arising… (etc.) … for whom an unwholesome mind is arising… for whom an indeterminate mind is arising… for whom a mind associated with pleasant feeling is arising…?

(Etena upāyena yāva saraṇaaraṇā uddharitabbā.)

(By this method, they should be drawn out up to the section on 'with conflict' and 'without conflict'.)

(Ka) yassa araṇaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa araṇaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati?

For whom a mind without conflict is arising and not ceasing, for them, will that mind without conflict cease and not arise?

(Kha) yassa vā pana araṇaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati tassa araṇaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati?

Or again, for whomever a mind without conflict will cease and not arise, for them, is that mind without conflict arising and not ceasing?

(Kha) niddeso

Exposition

1. Suddhacittasāmaññaṃ

1. The Common Feature of a Pure Mind

1. Puggalavāro

1. The Section on Individuals

(1) Uppādanirodhakālasambhedavāro

(1) The Section on the Combination of the Times of Arising and Cessation

63. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0301][V 2.0388] cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissatīti?

63. For whom a mind is arising and not ceasing, for them, will that mind cease and not arise?

Pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati, nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati, nirujjhissati ceva uppajjissati ca.

For those at the arising-moment of the final mind, their mind is arising and not ceasing; it will cease and not arise. For others at the arising-moment of a mind, their mind is arising and not ceasing; it will both cease and arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati tassa [T 2.0015] cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will cease and not arise, for that person, is the mind arising and not ceasing? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissatīti? No.

(Ka) For whom a mind is not arising but is ceasing, for that person, will the mind not cease but arise? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will not cease but will arise, for that person, is the mind not arising but ceasing? There is no such person.

(2) Uppāduppannavāro

(2) The Section on Arising and Arisen

64. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjati tassa cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

64. (Ka) For whom a mind is arising, has their mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has arisen, is their mind arising?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannañceva uppajjati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the mind, their mind has arisen, but their mind is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of the mind, their mind has both arisen and is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0389] cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Ka) For whom a mind is not arising, has their mind not arisen?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppannaṃ.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the mind, their mind is not arising, but it is not that their mind has not arisen. For those who have entered the attainment of cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind is neither arising nor has it arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has not arisen, is their mind not arising? Yes.

(3) Nirodhuppannavāro

(3) The Section on Cessation and the Arisen

65. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

65. (Ka) For whom a mind is ceasing, has their mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has arisen, is their mind ceasing?

Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannañceva nirujjhati ca.

For those at the arising-moment of the mind, their mind has arisen, but their mind is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of the mind, their mind has both arisen and is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa [M 2.0302] cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Ka) For whom a mind is not ceasing, has their mind not arisen?

Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca uppannaṃ[T 2.0016].

For those at the arising-moment of the mind, their mind is not ceasing, but it is not that their mind has not arisen. For those who have entered the attainment of cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind is neither ceasing nor has it arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has not arisen, is their mind not ceasing? Yes.

(4) Uppādavāro

(4) The Section on Arising

66. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjati tassa cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

66. (Ka) For whom a mind is arising, has their mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has arisen, is their mind arising?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha ceva uppajjati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the mind, for those who have entered the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind has arisen, but their mind is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of the mind, their mind has both arisen and is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0390] cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Ka) For whom a mind is not arising, has their mind not arisen? It has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has not arisen, is their mind not arising? There is none.

67. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjati tassa cittaṃ uppajjissatīti?

67. (Ka) For whom a mind is arising, will their mind arise?

Pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati ceva uppajjissati ca.

For those at the arising-moment of the final mind, their mind is arising, but their mind will not arise. For the others, at the arising-moment of the mind, their mind is both arising and will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will arise, is their mind arising?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati ceva uppajjati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the mind, for those who have entered the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind will arise, but their mind is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of the mind, their mind both will arise and is arising.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whom a mind is not arising, will their mind not arise?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppajjissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the mind, for those who have entered the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind is not arising, but it is not that their mind will not arise. For those at the dissolution-moment of the final mind, their mind is neither arising nor will it arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na [T 2.0017] uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will not arise, is their mind not arising?

Pacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjissati na ca uppajjati.

At the arising-moment of the final mind, their mind will not arise, but it is not that their mind is not arising. At the dissolution-moment of the final mind, their mind neither will arise nor is it arising.

68. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ uppajjissatīti?

68. (Ka) For whom a mind has arisen, will their mind arise?

Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha ceva uppajjissati ca.

For those endowed with the final mind, their mind has arisen, but their mind will not arise. For the others, their mind has both arisen and will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will arise, has their mind arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [M 2.0303][V 2.0391] cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whom a mind has not arisen, will their mind not arise? There is none.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will not arise, has their mind not arisen? It has arisen.

(5) Nirodhavāro

(5) The Section on Cessation

69. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

69. (Ka) For whom a mind is ceasing, has their mind ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom a mind has ceased, is their mind ceasing?

Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha ceva nirujjhati ca.

For those at the arising-moment of mind, for those who have entered the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind has ceased, but their mind is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of mind, their mind both has ceased and is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Ka) For whom the mind is not ceasing, has their mind not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind has not ceased, is their mind not ceasing? There is not.

70. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

70. (Ka) For whom the mind is ceasing, will their mind cease?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati ceva nirujjhissati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final mind, their mind is ceasing, but their mind will not cease. For the others, their mind both is ceasing and will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati tassa [T 2.0018] cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will cease, is their mind ceasing?

Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati ceva nirujjhati ca.

For those at the arising-moment of mind, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind will cease, but their mind is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of mind, their mind both will cease and is ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Nirujjhissati.

(Ka) For whom the mind is not ceasing, will their mind not cease? It will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Nirujjhati.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will not cease, is their mind not ceasing? It is ceasing.

71. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0392] cittaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

71. (Ka) For whom the mind has ceased, will their mind cease?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha ceva nirujjhissati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final mind, their mind has ceased, but their mind will not cease. For the others, their mind both has ceased and will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will cease, has their mind ceased? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whom the mind has not ceased, will their mind not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will not cease, has their mind not ceased? It has ceased.

(6) Uppādanirodhavāro

(6) The Section on Arising and Cessation

72. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? Āmantā.

72. (Ka) For whom the mind is arising, has their mind ceased? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha tassa cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind has ceased, is their mind arising?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ [M 2.0304] asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha ceva uppajjati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of mind, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind has ceased, but their mind is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of mind, their mind both has ceased and is arising.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti? Nirujjhittha.

(Ka) For whom the mind is not arising, has their mind not ceased? It has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind has not ceased, is their mind not arising? There is not.

73. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

73. (Ka) For whom the mind is arising, will their mind cease? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will cease, is their mind arising?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ [T 2.0019] tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati ceva uppajjati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of mind, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind will cease, but their mind is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of mind, their mind both will cease and is arising.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0393] cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom the mind is not arising, will their mind not cease?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca nirujjhissati.

For those at the dissolution-moment of mind, for those who have attained the attainment of cessation, and for non-percipient beings, their mind is not arising, but it is not that their mind will not cease. At the dissolution-moment of the final mind, their mind neither is arising nor will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will not cease, is their mind not arising? Yes.

74. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti?

74. (Ka) For whom the mind has arisen, will their mind cease?

Pacchimacittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati. Itaresaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha ceva nirujjhissati ca.

For those at the dissolution-moment of the final mind, their mind has arisen, but their mind will not cease. For the others, their mind both has arisen and will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will cease, has their mind arisen? Yes.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whom the mind has not arisen, will their mind not cease? There is not.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind will not cease, has their mind not arisen? It has arisen.

(7) Uppajjamānananirodhavāro

(7) The Section on the Presently Arising and Cessation

75. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjati tassa cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

75. (Ka) For whom the mind is arising, is their mind not ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind is not ceasing, is their mind arising?

Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ [T 2.0020] uppajjati. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati ceva uppajjati ca.

For those who have attained the attainment of cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind is not ceasing, but their mind is not arising. For those at the arising-moment of mind, their mind both is not ceasing and is arising.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Ka) For whom the mind is not arising, is their mind ceasing?

Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati ceva nirujjhati ca.

For those who have attained the attainment of cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind is not arising, but their mind is not ceasing. For those at the dissolution-moment of mind, their mind both is not arising and is ceasing.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind is ceasing, is their mind not arising? Yes.

(8) Uppajjamānuppannavāro

(8) The Section on the Presently Arising and the Arisen

76. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0305][V 2.0394] cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ tassa cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

76. (Ka) For whom the mind is arising, is their mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ uppajjamānanti?

(Kha) Or again, for whom the mind has arisen, is their mind arising?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ. Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannañceva uppajjamānañca.

For those at the moment of dissolution of mind, their mind has arisen, but their mind is not arising. For those at the moment of arising of mind, their mind is both arisen and arising.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ tassa cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Ka) For whom the mind is not arising, is their mind not arisen?

Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjamānaṃ na ca uppannaṃ.

For those at the moment of dissolution of mind, their mind is not arising, but their mind has arisen. For those who have attained cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind is neither arising nor arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ na uppajjamānanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom the mind has not arisen, is their mind not arising? Yes.

(9) Nirujjhamānuppannavāro

(9) The Section on Ceasing and Arisen

77. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ tassa cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

77. (Ka) For whom the mind is ceasing, is their mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ nirujjhamānanti?

(Kha) Or, for whom the mind has arisen, is their mind ceasing?

Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ. Cittassa bhaṅgakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannañceva nirujjhamānañca.

For those at the moment of arising of mind, their mind has arisen, but their mind is not ceasing. For those at the moment of dissolution of mind, their mind is both arisen and ceasing.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ tassa cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Ka) For whom the mind is not ceasing, is their mind not arisen?

Cittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhamānaṃ na ca uppannaṃ.

For those at the moment of arising of mind, their mind is not ceasing, but their mind has arisen. For those who have attained cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind is neither ceasing nor arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa [T 2.0021] cittaṃ na nirujjhamānanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whom the mind has not arisen, is their mind not ceasing? Yes.

(10) Uppannuppādavāro

(10) The Section on the Arisen and the Past

78. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0395] cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

78. (Ka) For whom a mind is present, has a mind arisen for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ uppannanti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has arisen, is a mind present for them?

Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Cittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha ceva uppannañca.

For those who have attained cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind has arisen, but their mind is not present. For those endowed with mind, their mind both has arisen and is present.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Ka) For whom a mind is not present, has a mind not arisen for them? It has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa cittaṃ na uppannanti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind has not arisen, is a mind not present for them? There is no such case.

79. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ uppajjissatīti?

79. (Ka) For whom a mind is present, will a mind arise for them?

Pacchimacittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ cittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ [M 2.0306] cittaṃ uppannañceva uppajjissati ca.

For those endowed with the final mind, their mind is present, but their mind will not arise. For the other beings endowed with mind, their mind both is present and will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ uppannanti?

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will arise, is a mind present for them?

Nirodhasamāpannānaṃ asaññasattānaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati, no ca tesaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ. Cittasamaṅgīnaṃ tesaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati ceva uppannañca.

For those who have attained cessation and for non-percipient beings, their mind will arise, but their mind is not present. For those endowed with mind, their mind both will arise and is present.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti? Uppajjissati.

(Ka) For whom a mind is not present, will a mind not arise for them? It will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati tassa cittaṃ na uppannanti? Uppannaṃ.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will not arise, is a mind not present for them? It is present.

(11) Atītānāgatavāro

(11) The Section on the Past and Future

80. (Ka) yassa cittaṃ uppajjittha no ca tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

80. (Ka) For whom a mind has arisen, but for them a mind is not present, will a mind arise for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati no ca tassa cittaṃ uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will arise, but for them a mind is not present, has a mind arisen for them? Yes.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0396] cittaṃ na uppajjittha no ca tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa [T 2.0022] cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti? Natthi.

(Ka) For whom a mind has not arisen, but for them a mind is present, will a mind not arise for them? There is no such case.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati no ca tassa cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, tassa cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti? Uppajjittha.

(Kha) Or for whom a mind will not arise, but for them a mind is present, has a mind not arisen for them? It has arisen.

(12) Uppannuppajjamānavāro

(12) The Section on the Arisen and the Arising

81. (Ka) uppannaṃ uppajjamānanti?

81. (Ka) Is that which is present also arising?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe uppannaṃ, no ca uppajjamānaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe uppannañceva uppajjamānañca.

At the moment of dissolution, it is present, but it is not arising. At the moment of arising, it both is present and is arising.

(Kha) uppajjamānaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is that which is arising also present? Yes.

(Ka) na uppannaṃ na uppajjamānanti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is that which is not present also not arising? Yes.

(Kha) na uppajjamānaṃ na uppannanti?

(Kha) Is that which is not arising also not present?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe na uppajjamānaṃ, no ca na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjamānaṃ na ca uppannaṃ.

At the moment of dissolution, it is not arising, but it is present. Past and future mind is neither arising nor is it present.

(13) Niruddhanirujjhamānavāro

(13) The Section on the Ceased and the Ceasing

82. (Ka) niruddhaṃ nirujjhamānanti? No.

82. (Ka) Is that which has ceased also ceasing? No.

(Kha) nirujjhamānaṃ niruddhanti? No.

(Kha) Is that which is ceasing also ceased? No.

(Ka) na niruddhaṃ na nirujjhamānanti?

(Ka) Is that which is not ceased also not ceasing?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe na niruddhaṃ, no ca na nirujjhamānaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva niruddhaṃ na ca nirujjhamānaṃ.

At the moment of dissolution, it is not ceased, but it is ceasing. The mind at the moment of arising and the future mind are neither ceased nor ceasing.

(Kha) na nirujjhamānaṃ na niruddhanti?

(b) Is that which is not ceasing also not ceased?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, no ca na niruddhaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhamānaṃ na ca niruddhaṃ.

The past mind is not ceasing, but it has indeed ceased. The mind at the moment of arising and the future mind are neither ceasing nor ceased.

(14) Atikkantakālavāro

(14) The Section on Time That Has Passed

83. (Ka) yassa [M 2.0307][V 2.0397] cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittanti?

83. (a) For a person for whom the moment of the mind's arising has passed beyond, its time having passed, has the moment of that person's mind's ceasing also passed beyond, its time having passed?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppādakkhaṇaṃ vītakkantaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇaṃ avītikkantaṃ, atītaṃ cittaṃ uppādakkhaṇañca vītikkantaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇañca vītikkantaṃ.

For the mind at the moment of dissolution, the moment of arising has passed beyond, but the moment of dissolution has not passed beyond. For the past mind, both the moment of arising and the moment of dissolution have passed beyond.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ [T 2.0023] khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittanti?

(b) Or again, for a person for whom the moment of the mind's ceasing has passed beyond, its time having passed, has the moment of that person's mind's arising also passed beyond, its time having passed?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ.

The past mind.

(Ka) yassa cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittanti?

(a) For a person for whom the moment of the mind's arising has not passed beyond, its time not having passed, has the moment of that person's mind's ceasing also not passed beyond, its time not having passed?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgataṃ cittaṃ.

The mind at the moment of arising and the future mind.

(Kha) yassa vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ tassa cittanti?

(b) Or again, for a person for whom the moment of the mind's ceasing has not passed beyond, its time not having passed, has the moment of that person's mind's arising also not passed beyond, its time not having passed?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇaṃ avītikkantaṃ no ca uppādakkhaṇaṃ avītikkantaṃ, uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇañca avītikkantaṃ uppādakkhaṇañca avītikkantaṃ.

For the mind at the moment of dissolution, the moment of dissolution has not passed beyond, but it is not the case that the moment of arising has not passed beyond. For the mind at the moment of arising and the future mind, both the moment of dissolution and the moment of arising have not passed beyond.

1. Suddhacittasāmañña

1. General Section on the Mind

2. Dhammavāro

2. The Section on Phenomena

(1) Uppādanirodhakālasambhedavāro

(1) The Section on the Interrelation of the Times of Arising and Cessation

84. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

84. (a) The mind that is arising and not ceasing—will that mind cease and not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ [V 2.0398] vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, the mind that will cease and not arise—is that mind arising and not ceasing? Yes.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissatīti? No.

(a) The mind that is not arising but is ceasing—will that mind not cease but arise? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

(b) Or again, the mind that will not cease but will arise—is that mind not arising but ceasing? It does not exist.

(2) Uppāduppannavāro

(2) The Section on Arising and the Arisen

85. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

85. (a) Is the mind that is arising, that mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, is the mind that has arisen, that mind arising?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannañceva uppajjati ca.

At the moment of dissolution, the mind has arisen, but that mind is not arising. At the moment of arising, the mind has both arisen and is arising.

(Ka) yaṃ [M 2.0308] cittaṃ na uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ na [T 2.0024] uppannanti?

(a) Is the mind that is not arising, that mind not arisen?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppannaṃ.

At the moment of dissolution, the mind is not arising, but it is not the case that that mind has not arisen. A past or future mind neither is arising nor has arisen.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, is the mind that has not arisen, that mind not arising? Yes.

(3) Nirodhuppannavāro

(3) The Section on Cessation and the Arisen

86. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

86. (a) Is the mind that is ceasing, that mind arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(b) Or again, is the mind that has arisen, that mind ceasing?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannañceva nirujjhati ca.

At the moment of arising, the mind has arisen, but that mind is not ceasing. At the moment of dissolution, the mind has both arisen and is ceasing.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(a) Is the mind that is not ceasing, that mind not arisen?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca uppannaṃ.

At the moment of arising, the mind is not ceasing, but it is not the case that that mind has not arisen. A past or future mind neither is ceasing nor has arisen.

(Kha) yaṃ [V 2.0399] vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(b) Or again, is the mind that has not arisen, that mind not ceasing? Yes.

(4) Uppādavāro

(4) The Section on Arising

87. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

87. (a) The mind that is arising—did that mind arise? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(b) Or again, the mind that arose—is that mind arising? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti?

(a) The mind that is not arising—did that mind not arise?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppajjittha.

A past mind is not arising, but it is not the case that that mind did not arise. A mind at the moment of dissolution and a future mind neither is arising nor arose.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti?

(b) Or again, the mind that did not arise—is that mind not arising?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjittha na ca uppajjati.

At the moment of arising, a mind did not arise, but it is not the case that that mind is not arising. A mind at the moment of dissolution and a future mind neither arose nor is arising.

88. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? No.

88. (a) The mind that is arising—will that mind arise? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

Or, is the mind that will arise, that mind arising? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati taṃ [T 2.0025] cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti?

Is the mind that is not arising, that mind one that will not arise?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe atītañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppajjissati.

A future mind is not arising, but it is not that that mind will not arise. A present mind at the moment of dissolution and a past mind neither is arising nor will arise.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti?

Or, is the mind that will not arise, that mind not arising?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe atītañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjissati na ca uppajjati.

A present mind at the moment of arising will not arise, but it is not that that mind is not arising. A present mind at the moment of dissolution and a past mind neither will arise nor is arising.

89. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? No.

89. Is the mind that arose, that mind one that will arise? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

Or, is a mind that will arise a mind that arose? No.

(Ka) yaṃ [M 2.0309][V 2.0400] cittaṃ na uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti?

Is the mind that did not arise, that mind one that will not arise?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Paccuppannaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjittha na ca uppajjissati.

A future mind has not arisen, but it is not that that mind will not arise. A present mind has neither arisen nor will arise.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti?

Or, is the mind that will not arise, that mind one that has not arisen?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Paccuppannaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjissati na ca uppajjittha.

A past mind will not arise, but it is not that that mind has not arisen. A present mind will neither arise nor has arisen.

(5) Nirodhavāro

(5) The Section on Cessation

90. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? No.

Is the mind that is ceasing, that mind one that has ceased? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

Or, is the mind that has ceased, that mind one that is ceasing? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

90. Is the mind that is not ceasing, that mind one that has not ceased?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca nirujjhittha.

A past mind is not ceasing, but it is not that that mind has not ceased. A present mind at the moment of arising and a future mind are neither ceasing nor have ceased.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or, is the mind that has not ceased, that mind one that is not ceasing?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhittha na [T 2.0026] ca nirujjhati.

A present mind at the moment of dissolution has not ceased, but it is not that that mind is not ceasing. A present mind at the moment of arising and a future mind have neither ceased nor are ceasing.

91. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? No.

Is the mind that is ceasing, that mind one that will cease? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

Or, is the mind that will cease, that mind one that is ceasing? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

91. Is the mind that is not ceasing, that mind one that will not cease?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Atītaṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca nirujjhissati.

A present mind at the moment of arising and a future mind are not ceasing, but it is not that those minds will not cease. A past mind is neither ceasing nor will cease.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

Or, is the mind that will not cease, that mind one that is not ceasing?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Atītaṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhissati na ca nirujjhati.

A present mind at the moment of dissolution will not cease, but it is not that that mind is not ceasing. A past mind will neither cease nor is ceasing.

92. (Ka) yaṃ [V 2.0401] cittaṃ nirujjhittha taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? No.

Is the mind that has ceased, that mind one that will cease? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? No.

Or, is the mind that will cease, that mind one that has ceased? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

92. Is the mind that has not ceased, that mind one that will not cease?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhittha na ca nirujjhissati.

A present mind at the moment of arising and a future mind have not ceased, but it is not that those minds will not cease. A present mind at the moment of dissolution has neither ceased nor will cease.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

Or, is the mind that will not cease, that mind one that has not ceased?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhissati na ca nirujjhittha.

A past mind will not cease, but it is not that that mind has not ceased. A present mind at the moment of dissolution will neither cease nor has ceased.

(6) Uppādanirodhavāro

(6) The Section on Arising and Cessation

93. (Ka) yaṃ [M 2.0310] cittaṃ uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? No.

Is it that the mind which is arising has ceased? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhittha taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

Or, is it that the mind which has ceased is arising? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

Is it that the mind which is not arising has not ceased?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ [T 2.0027] na ceva uppajjati na ca nirujjhittha.

93. A past mind is not arising, but it is not that that mind has not ceased. A present mind at the moment of dissolution and a future mind neither are arising nor have ceased.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhittha taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti?

Or, is it that the mind which has not ceased is not arising?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhittha na ca uppajjati.

A present mind at the moment of arising has not ceased, but it is not that that mind is not arising. A present mind at the moment of dissolution and a future mind neither have ceased nor are arising.

94. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? Āmantā.

Is it that the mind which is arising will cease? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

Or, is it that the mind which will cease is arising?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ nirujjhissati ceva uppajjati ca.

A future mind will cease, but that mind is not arising. A present mind at the moment of arising both will cease and is arising.

(Ka) yaṃ [V 2.0402] cittaṃ na uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

Is it that the mind which is not arising will not cease?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe atītañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca nirujjhissati.

A future mind is not arising, but that mind will cease. A present mind at the moment of dissolution and a past mind are neither arising nor will cease.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or, is it that the mind which will not cease is not arising? Yes.

95. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? No.

95. Is it that the mind which has arisen will cease? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

Or, is it that the mind which will cease has arisen? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

Is it that the mind which has not arisen will not cease?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na ceva uppajjittha na ca nirujjhissati.

A present mind at the moment of arising and a future mind have not arisen, but those minds will cease. A present mind at the moment of dissolution has neither arisen nor will cease.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhissati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti?

Or, is it that the mind which will not cease has not arisen?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhissati na ca uppajjittha.

A past mind will not cease, but that mind has arisen. A present mind at the moment of dissolution will neither cease nor has arisen.

(7) Uppajjamāna-nanirodhavāro

(7) The Section on Arising and Non-Cessation

96. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

Is it that whichever mind is arising, that mind is not ceasing? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ [T 2.0028] vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

96. Or, is it that whichever mind is not ceasing, that mind is arising?

Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhati ceva uppajjati ca.

A past and future mind is not ceasing, but that mind is not arising. A mind at the moment of arising is both not ceasing and is arising.

(Ka) yaṃ [M 2.0311] cittaṃ na uppajjati taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

Is it that whichever mind is not arising, that mind is ceasing?

Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjati ceva nirujjhati ca.

A past and future mind is not arising, but that mind is not ceasing. A mind at the moment of dissolution is both not arising and is ceasing.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhati taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

Or, is it that whichever mind is ceasing, that mind is not arising? Yes.

(8) Uppajjamānuppannavāro

(8) The Section on Arising and Arisen

97. (Ka) yaṃ [V 2.0403] cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

Is it that whichever mind is arising, that mind is arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānanti?

Or, is it that whichever mind is arisen, that mind is arising?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannañceva uppajjamānañca.

97. A mind at the moment of dissolution is arisen, but that mind is not arising. A mind at the moment of arising is both arisen and arising.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

Is it that whichever mind is not arising, that mind is not arisen?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjamānaṃ na ca uppannaṃ.

A mind at the moment of dissolution is not arising, but that mind is arisen.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānanti? Āmantā.

Or, is it that whichever mind is not arisen, that mind is not arising? Yes.

(9) Nirujjhamānuppannavāro

(9) The Section on Ceasing and Arisen

98. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

Is it that whichever mind is ceasing, that mind is arisen? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānanti?

Or, is it that whichever mind is arisen, that mind is ceasing?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannañceva nirujjhamānañca.

A mind at the moment of arising is arisen, but that mind is not ceasing. A mind at the moment of dissolution is both arisen and ceasing.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

98. Is it that whichever mind is not ceasing, that mind is not arisen?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhamānaṃ na ca uppannaṃ[T 2.0029].

A mind at the moment of arising is not ceasing, but that mind is arisen. A past and future mind is neither ceasing nor arisen.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānanti? Āmantā.

Or, is it that whichever mind is not arisen, that mind is not ceasing? Yes.

(10) Uppannuppādavāro

(10) The Section on the Arisen and the Arising

99. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

99. (Ka) Is a mind that has arisen a mind that arose? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? No.

(Kha) Or, is a mind that arose a mind that has arisen? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti?

(Ka) Is a mind that has not arisen a mind that did not arise?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppannaṃ na ca uppajjittha.

A past mind has not arisen, yet it is not the case that that mind did not arise. A future mind has neither arisen nor did it arise.

(Kha) yaṃ [V 2.0404] vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjittha taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Kha) Or, is a mind that did not arise a mind that has not arisen?

Paccuppannaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjittha na ca uppannaṃ.

A present mind did not arise, yet it is not the case that that mind has not arisen. A future mind neither did arise nor has arisen.

100. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? No.

100. (Ka) Is a mind that has arisen a mind that will arise? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? No.

(Kha) Or, is a mind that will arise a mind that has arisen? No.

(Ka) yaṃ [M 2.0312] cittaṃ na uppannaṃ taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) Is a mind that has not arisen a mind that will not arise?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Atītaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppannaṃ na ca uppajjissati.

A future mind has not arisen, but it is not that it will not arise. A past mind has neither arisen nor will it arise.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Kha) Or, is a mind that will not arise, a mind that has not arisen?

Paccuppannaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjissati na ca uppannaṃ.

A present mind will not arise, but it is not that it has not arisen. A past mind will neither arise nor has arisen.

(11) Atītānāgatavāro

(11) The Section on the Past and Future

101. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? No.

101. (Ka) Will a mind that arose but has not arisen, arise? No.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ uppajjissati no ca taṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

(Kha) Or, did a mind that will arise but has not arisen, arise? No.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti? Āmantā[T 2.0030].

(Ka) Will a mind that did not arise, but has arisen, not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na uppajjissati no ca taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ, taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, did a mind that will not arise, but has arisen, not arise? Yes.

(12) Uppannuppajjamānavāro

(12) The Section on the Arisen and the Arising

102. (Ka) uppannaṃ [V 2.0405] uppajjamānanti?

102. (Ka) Is what has arisen, arising?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe uppannaṃ, no ca uppajjamānaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe uppannañceva uppajjamānañca.

At the moment of dissolution, it is arisen but not arising. At the moment of arising, it is both arisen and arising.

(Kha) uppajjamānaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Is what is arising, arisen? Yes.

(Ka) na uppannaṃ na uppajjamānanti? Āmantā.

(Ka) Is what is not arisen, not arising? Yes.

(Kha) na uppajjamānaṃ na uppannanti?

(Kha) Is what is not arising, not arisen?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe na uppajjamānaṃ, no ca na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjamānaṃ na ca uppannaṃ.

At the moment of dissolution, it is not arising, but it is not that it is not arisen. A past and future mind is neither arising nor arisen.

(13) Niruddhanirujjhamānavāro

(13) The Section on the Ceased and the Ceasing

103. (Ka) niruddhaṃ nirujjhamānanti? No.

103. (Ka) Is the ceased, ceasing? No.

(Kha) nirujjhamānaṃ niruddhanti? No.

(Kha) Is the ceasing, ceased? No.

(Ka) na niruddhaṃ na nirujjhamānanti?

(Ka) Is the not-ceased, not-ceasing?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe na niruddhaṃ, no ca na nirujjhamānaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva niruddhaṃ na ca nirujjhamānaṃ.

At the moment of dissolution, it is not ceased, but it is not that it is not ceasing. At the moment of arising and the future mind, it is neither ceased nor ceasing.

(Kha) na nirujjhamānaṃ na niruddhanti?

(Kha) Is the not-ceasing, not-ceased?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ, no ca na niruddhaṃ. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhamānaṃ na ca niruddhaṃ.

The past mind is not ceasing, but it is not that it is not ceased. At the moment of arising and the future mind, it is neither ceasing nor ceased.

(14) Atikkantakālavāro

(14) The Section on Elapsed Time

104. (Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittanti?

104. (Ka) Is it that mind of which the arising moment has passed and is past time, and of which the ceasing moment has passed and is past time?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppādakkhaṇaṃ [M 2.0313] vītikkantaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇaṃ avītikkantaṃ[V 2.0406], atītaṃ cittaṃ uppādakkhaṇañca vītikkantaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇañca vītikkantaṃ.

For the mind at the moment of dissolution, the moment of arising has passed, but the moment of dissolution has not passed. For the past mind, both the moment of arising and the moment of dissolution have passed.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittanti?

(Kha) Or again, is it that mind of which the ceasing moment has passed and is past time, and of which the arising moment has passed and is past time?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ[T 2.0031].

The past mind.

(Ka) yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittanti?

(Ka) Is it that mind of which the arising moment has not passed and is not past time, and of which the ceasing moment has not passed and is not past time?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgataṃ cittaṃ.

The mind at the moment of arising and the future mind.

(Kha) yaṃ vā pana cittaṃ na nirujjhamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ, na uppajjamānaṃ khaṇaṃ khaṇaṃ vītikkantaṃ atikkantakālaṃ taṃ cittanti?

(Kha) Or again, is it that mind of which the ceasing moment has not passed and is not past time, and of which the arising moment has not passed and is not past time?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇaṃ avītikkantaṃ no ca uppādakkhaṇaṃ avītikkantaṃ, uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ bhaṅgakkhaṇañca avītikkantaṃ uppādakkhaṇañca avītikkantaṃ.

For the mind at the moment of dissolution, the moment of dissolution has not passed, but it is not that the moment of arising has not passed. For the mind at the moment of arising and the future mind, neither the moment of dissolution nor the moment of arising has passed.

1. Suddhacittasāmañña

1. General Section on Mind Only

3. Puggaladhammavāro

3. The Section on Individuals and Phenomena

(1) Uppādanirodhakālasambhedavāro

(1) The Section on the Combination of the Times of Arising and Cessation

105. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissatīti? Āmantā.

105. (Ka) For whomsoever a certain mind arises and does not cease, for them will that mind cease and not arise? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever a certain mind will cease and not arise, for them does that mind arise and not cease? Yes.

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissatīti? No.

(Ka) For whomsoever a certain mind does not arise but ceases, for them will that mind not cease but arise? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati nirujjhatīti? Natthi.

(Kha) Or again, for whomsoever a certain mind will not cease but will arise, for them does that mind not arise but cease? There is no such case.

(2) Uppāduppannavāro

(2) The Section on Arising and the Arisen

106. (Ka) yassa [V 2.0407] yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

106. (Ka) For whomsoever a certain mind arises, has that mind arisen for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness has arisen, does that consciousness arise for them?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjati. Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannañceva uppajjati ca.

At the moment of dissolution, consciousness has arisen, but that consciousness does not arise. At the moment of arising, consciousness has both arisen and arises.

(Ka) yassa [T 2.0032] yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness does not arise, has that consciousness not arisen for them?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati [M 2.0314] na ca uppannaṃ.

At the moment of dissolution, consciousness does not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness has not arisen. Past and future consciousness neither arises nor has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness has not arisen, does that consciousness not arise for them? Yes.

(3) Nirodhuppannavāro

(3) The Section on Cessation and the Arisen

107. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppannanti? Āmantā.

107. (Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness ceases, has that consciousness arisen for them? Yes.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppannaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness has arisen, does that consciousness cease for them?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannaṃ, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ uppannañceva nirujjhati ca.

At the moment of arising, consciousness has arisen, but that consciousness does not cease. At the moment of dissolution, consciousness has both arisen and ceases.

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannanti?

(Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness does not cease, has that consciousness not arisen for them?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ. Atītānāgataṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca uppannaṃ.

At the moment of arising, consciousness does not cease, but it is not the case that that consciousness has not arisen. Past and future consciousness neither ceases nor has arisen.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppannaṃ tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti? Āmantā.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness has not arisen, does that consciousness not cease for them? Yes.

(4) Uppādavāro

(4) The Section on Arising

108. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

108. (Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness arises, did that consciousness arise for them? No.

(Kha) yassa [V 2.0408] vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness did arise, does that consciousness arise for them? No.

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti?

(Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness does not arise, did that consciousness not arise for them?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppajjittha.

Past consciousness does not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness did not arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and future consciousness neither arise nor did arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness did not arise, does that consciousness not arise for them?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjittha [T 2.0033] na ca uppajjati.

At the moment of arising, consciousness did not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness does not arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and future consciousness neither did arise nor does arise.

109. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? No.

109. (Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness arises, will that consciousness arise for them? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjatīti? No.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness will arise, does that consciousness arise for them? No.

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness does not arise, will that consciousness not arise for them?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe atītañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjati na ca uppajjissati.

Future consciousness does not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness will not arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and past consciousness neither arise nor will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness will not arise, does that consciousness not arise for them?

Uppādakkhaṇe cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe atītañca cittaṃ na ceva uppajjissati na ca uppajjati.

At the moment of arising, consciousness will not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness does not arise. Consciousness at the moment of dissolution and past consciousness neither will arise nor does arise.

110. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjissatīti? No.

110. (Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness did arise, will that consciousness arise for them? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ uppajjitthāti? No.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness will arise, did that consciousness arise for them? No.

(Ka) yassa [M 2.0315][V 2.0409] yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissatīti?

(Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness did not arise, will that consciousness not arise for them?

Anāgataṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati. Paccuppannaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjittha na ca uppajjissati.

Future consciousness did not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness will not arise. Present consciousness neither did arise nor will arise.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness will not arise, did that consciousness not arise for them?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na uppajjissati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na uppajjittha. Paccuppannaṃ cittaṃ na ceva uppajjissati na ca uppajjittha.

Past consciousness will not arise, but it is not the case that that consciousness did not arise. Present consciousness neither will arise nor did arise.

(5) Nirodhavāro

(5) The Section on Cessation

111. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? No.

111. (Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness ceases, has that consciousness ceased for them? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness has ceased, does that consciousness cease for them? No.

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness does not cease, has that consciousness not ceased for them?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ [T 2.0034] na nirujjhati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca nirujjhittha.

Past consciousness does not cease, but it is not the case that that consciousness has not ceased. Consciousness at the moment of arising and future consciousness neither ceases nor has ceased.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness has not ceased, does that consciousness not cease for them?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhittha na ca nirujjhati.

At the moment of dissolution, consciousness has not ceased, but it is not the case that that consciousness does not cease. Consciousness at the moment of arising and future consciousness neither has ceased nor does cease.

112. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? No.

112. (Ka) For whomsoever any consciousness ceases, will that consciousness cease for them? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhatīti? No.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever any consciousness will cease, does that consciousness cease for them? No.

(Ka) yassa [V 2.0410] yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom a certain consciousness does not cease, will that consciousness not cease for them?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na nirujjhati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Atītaṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhati na ca nirujjhissati.

For a consciousness at the moment of arising, and for a future consciousness, it does not cease, but for them that consciousness will cease. A past consciousness neither ceases nor will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhatīti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever a certain consciousness will not cease, does that consciousness not cease for them?

Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhati. Atītaṃ cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhissati na ca nirujjhati.

At the moment of dissolution, a consciousness will not cease, but that consciousness does cease for them. A past consciousness neither will cease nor does cease.

113. (Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissatīti? No.

113. (Ka) For whom a certain consciousness has ceased, will that consciousness cease for them? No.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ nirujjhitthāti? No.

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever a certain consciousness will cease, has that consciousness ceased for them? No.

(Ka) yassa yaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissatīti?

(Ka) For whom a certain consciousness has not ceased, will that consciousness not cease for them?

Uppādakkhaṇe anāgatañca cittaṃ na nirujjhittha, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ na ceva nirujjhittha na ca nirujjhissati.

For a consciousness at the moment of arising, and for a future consciousness, it has not ceased, but for them that consciousness will cease. At the moment of dissolution, a consciousness neither has ceased nor will cease.

(Kha) yassa vā pana yaṃ cittaṃ na [M 2.0316] nirujjhissati tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhitthāti?

(Kha) Or, for whomsoever a certain consciousness will not cease, has that consciousness not ceased for them?

Atītaṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhissati, no ca tassa taṃ cittaṃ na nirujjhittha. Bhaṅgakkhaṇe cittaṃ [T 2.0035] na ceva nirujjhissati na ca nirujjhittha.

A past consciousness will not cease, but that consciousness has ceased for them. At the moment of dissolution, a consciousness neither will cease nor has ceased.

(Yassa cittake sakabhāvena niddiṭṭhe, yaṃ cittake ca yassa yaṃ cittake ca ekattena niddiṭṭhe.)

(Herein, 'yassa citta' is designated by its own nature, while 'yaṃ citta' and 'yassa yaṃ citta' are designated as one.)

2. Suttantacittamissakaviseso

2. The Special Section on the Mixture of Suttanta and Consciousness.

114. Yassa [V 2.0411] sarāgaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa sarāgaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissatīti?

114. For whom a consciousness with lust arises but does not cease, for them will that consciousness with lust cease but not arise?

Sarāgapacchimacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ sarāgaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati, nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ sarāgacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ…pe….

At the moment of arising of the last consciousness with lust, for them a consciousness with lust arises but does not cease; it will cease but not arise. For others, at the moment of arising of a consciousness with lust, for them... and so on.

3. Abhidhammacittamissakaviseso

3. The Special Section on the Mixture of Abhidhamma and Consciousness.

115. Yassa kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati tassa kusalaṃ cittaṃ nirujjhissati na uppajjissatīti?

115. For whom a wholesome consciousness arises but does not cease, for them will that wholesome consciousness cease but not arise?

Pacchimakusalacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ kusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati, nirujjhissati na uppajjissati. Itaresaṃ kusalacittassa uppādakkhaṇe tesaṃ…pe….

At the moment of arising of the last wholesome consciousness, for them a wholesome consciousness arises but does not cease; it will cease but not arise. For others, at the moment of arising of a wholesome consciousness, for them... and so on.

Yassa vā pana…pe…? Āmantā …pe….

Or again, for whom...? Yes... and so on.

116. Yassa akusalaṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati…pe…. Yassa abyākataṃ cittaṃ uppajjati na nirujjhati…pe….

116. For whom an unwholesome consciousness arises but does not cease... and so on. For whom an indeterminate consciousness arises but does not cease... and so on.

(Mūlayamakaṃ cittayamakaṃ dhammayamakanti tīṇi yamakāni yāva saraṇaaraṇā gacchanti.)

(The Root Yamaka, the Consciousness Yamaka, and the Dhamma Yamaka are three Yamakas, extending as far as refuge and non-refuge.)

Cittayamakaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.

The Consciousness Yamaka is concluded.
